normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They decided to cancel the flight due to bad weather.
options: A. 他們因為天氣不好而決定延遲航班。

C. 儘管天氣不好，航班仍然起飛。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We are looking forward to receiving your feedback.
options: A. 我們正在查看您的意見回饋。

D. 我們不想收到任何意見回饋。
normal.explain: We are looking forward to receiving your feedback. 意思是「我們期待收到您的回饋。」（look forward to + V-ing 動名詞）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted making a mistake in the financial report.
options: A. 他承認在財務報告中犯了錯誤。

normal.explain: He admitted making a mistake in the financial report. 意思是「他承認在財務報告中犯了錯。」（admit + V-ing 動名詞）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
options: A. 醫生建議我多運動幾天。
B. 醫生建議我休息幾天。
C. 醫生拒絕讓我休息幾天。
D. 醫生命令我立刻回去工作。
normal.explain: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days. 意思是「醫生建議我休息幾天。」（advise sb to V）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The hotel which we stayed at was fully booked.
options: A. 我們想訂的飯店客滿了，所以沒住。
B. 我們住的那家飯店客滿了。
C. 那家客滿的飯店不是我們住的。
D. 我們住的飯店還有很多空房。
normal.explain: The hotel which we stayed at was fully booked. 意思是「我們住的那家飯店已經客滿了。」（關係代名詞 which）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I avoided talking to him because he was angry.
options: A. 因為他生氣了，所以我試著跟他說話。

C. 我跟他說話讓他變得更生氣了。

normal.explain: I avoided talking to him because he was angry. 意思是「我避免跟他說話，因為他正在生氣。」（avoid + V-ing 動名詞）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Were you taking notes during the presentation?
options: A. Yes, I was trying to capture all the key points.
B. No, I am giving the presentation tomorrow.
C. The notes are on the desk.
D. Yes, I will take some notes next time.
normal.explain: 問句：簡報時你有在做筆記嗎？（過去進行式）。A「有，我努力記下所有重點」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Is this the software that we need to install?
options: A. Yes, it's the one recommended by the IT department.
B. No, he is the software engineer.
C. Install it on your computer tomorrow.
D. Yes, the hardware is very expensive.
normal.explain: 問句：這是我們需要安裝的軟體嗎？（關係代名詞 that）。A「對，是資訊部門推薦的那套」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you mind waiting for a few more minutes?
options: A. Yes, I wait for a few minutes.
B. Not at all. I can wait.
C. My mind is full of ideas.
D. You should wait for him.
normal.explain: 問句：你介意多等幾分鐘嗎？（mind + V-ing）。B「一點也不介意，我可以等」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you considered taking a different flight?
options: A. I will take the bus yesterday.
B. Yes, but there are no other flights available today.
C. Considering the price, it is very cheap.
D. The flight was delayed for two hours.
normal.explain: 問句：你有考慮搭別的航班嗎？（consider + V-ing）。B「有，但今天沒有其他航班了」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Can I get a refund for this broken item?
options: A. Yes, the item is very beautiful.
B. We can process the refund if you have the receipt.
C. I will break the item again.
D. The fund is sufficient for the project.
normal.explain: 問句：這個壞掉的商品可以退款嗎？ B「如果你有收據，我們可以為您處理退款」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I was experiencing some pain in my lower back yesterday.
options: A. You should have told me you were going to the back of the line.
B. That sounds serious. Have you seen a doctor about it?
C. My back is perfectly fine.
D. It is an interesting experience.
normal.explain: 句子：我昨天背部下方有點痛（過去進行式）。B「聽起來很嚴重。你有去看醫生嗎？」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The colleague who helped me with the project is transferring to another branch.
options: A. Oh, really? Which branch is he going to?
B. The project was very successful.
C. I can help you with the transfer.
D. The branch of the tree is falling.
normal.explain: 句子：幫我做專案的那位同事要調去別的分公司了（關係代名詞 who）。A「噢真的嗎？他要去哪個分公司？」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We failed to reach an agreement during the meeting.
options: A. That's unfortunate. What are the next steps?
B. The meeting room is very large.
C. I agree with your statement completely.
D. Reaching the top of the mountain is hard.
normal.explain: 句子：我們未能在會議中達成共識（fail + to V）。A「真遺憾。那下一步是什麼？」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He suggested organizing a training session for the new employees.
options: A. The new employees are very tired.
B. That's a great idea to help them get started.
C. I suggest you go home early.
D. The organization is very profitable.
normal.explain: 句子：他建議為新進員工辦一場培訓課程（suggest + V-ing）。B「這是個幫助他們上手的好主意」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I am planning to visit Tokyo next month.
options: A. The plan was cancelled yesterday.
B. Tokyo is a great city. Have a good trip!
C. I visited Tokyo two years ago.
D. Planning is an important skill.
normal.explain: 句子：我打算下個月去東京玩（plan + to V）。B「東京是個很棒的城市。旅途愉快！」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 餵食
B. 背景
C. 意見回饋
D. 倒退
normal.explain: feedback 是「意見回饋」。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】測試關係代名詞 who 的用法
options: A. which
B. who
C. what
D. whose
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。題目「The engineer ___ fixed our network is highly skilled.」中，先行詞 engineer 是人，且在關係子句中作主詞，因此用 who。A 用於事物，C 不能當關係代名詞，D 用於表達所有格。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】測試關係代名詞 that 的用法
options: A. that
B. who
C. what
D. whom
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。題目「Please send me the document ___ you mentioned in the meeting.」中，先行詞 document 是事物，可用 which 或 that。選項中只有 that 符合。B與D用於人，C不能作關係代名詞。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】測試關係代名詞 which 的用法
options: A. that
B. who
C. where
D. which
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。題目「The restaurant, ___ was recommended by my colleague, has great food.」是「非限定用法」（有逗號），先行詞是事物時只能用 which，不能用 that。

normal.desc: 【時態】The marketing team ___ the new strategy when the CEO walked into the room.
options: A. discussed
B. is discussing
C. was discussing
D. has discussed
normal.explain: 由 when 帶出的過去簡單式（walked）可知，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作。

normal.desc: 【文法】We need a software developer ___ has experience in creating mobile applications.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whom
D. what
normal.explain: 先行詞是人（software developer），且在關係子句中作主詞，故使用 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】Our manager suggested ___ the weekly meeting to Thursday morning.
options: A. move
B. moving
C. to move
D. moved
normal.explain: suggest（建議）後面必須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞，不能接不定詞。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ an email to my colleague when my computer suddenly shut down.
options: A. write
B. will write
C. have written
D. was writing
normal.explain: 描述過去某個時間點正在發生的事（寫信），被另一個突發動作（關機）打斷，使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The flexible working hours ___ the company introduced have increased productivity.
options: A. who
B. what
C. that
D. where
normal.explain: 先行詞為事物（flexible working hours），可用 that 或 which 引導關係子句。

normal.desc: 【文法】A: Did you manage to finish the report? B: No, I stopped ___ a phone call, and then it was time to leave.
options: A. to answer
B. answering
C. answer
D. answered
normal.explain: stop to V 表示「停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事」；stop V-ing 則是「停止做那件事」。此處為停下來去接電話。

normal.desc: 【時態】While they ___ through the dense forest, they discovered a rare species of bird.
options: A. hike
B. were hiking
C. hiked
D. have hiked
normal.explain: While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，表示在過去一段持續的時間內（徒步旅行中）發生了另一件事（發現鳥類）。

normal.desc: 【文法】The eco-friendly packaging, ___ is made from recycled materials, is very popular among consumers.
options: A. that
B. which
C. who
D. what
normal.explain: 非限定用法（有逗號隔開）的關係子句中，修飾事物的關係代名詞只能用 which，不能用 that。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many employees plan ___ from home at least twice a week.
options: A. work
B. working
C. to work
D. worked
normal.explain: plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞（to V）當作受詞。

normal.desc: 【短文】Notice: The annual tech conference, which usually takes place in June, has been delayed to August. The venue will remain the same. Q: What is true about the tech conference?
options: A. It has been cancelled.
B. It will be held in a different location.
C. It usually happens in August.
D. Its schedule has been changed.
normal.explain: 短文中提到會議從六月延遲到八月（delayed to August），地點維持不變（remain the same），故選 D。

normal.desc: 【時態】At 8 PM last night, the technicians ___ the new artificial intelligence system.
options: A. are testing
B. test
C. were testing
D. tested
normal.explain: 句子明確點出過去的特定時間（At 8 PM last night），此時應使用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作。

normal.desc: 【文法】He is the innovative designer ___ created our company's new logo.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 先行詞是人（designer），在關係子句中作主詞（created的前面），因此用 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】I completely forgot ___ the office door when I left yesterday evening.
options: A. to lock
B. locking
C. lock
D. locked
normal.explain: forget to V 表示「忘記去做某事（事情還沒做）」；forget V-ing 表示「忘記已經做過某事」。句意是離開時忘記鎖門，故選 to lock。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: What ___ when the earthquake hit? B: I was reading a book in the living room.
options: A. are you doing
B. did you do
C. were you doing
D. have you done
normal.explain: 根據回答「I was reading...」以及 when 帶出的過去時間，問句需用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The factory ___ closed down last year used to employ over 500 local residents.
options: A. who
B. where
C. that
D. what
normal.explain: 修飾事物（The factory）並作為子句主詞的關係代名詞，可用 which 或 that，選項中只有 that 符合。

normal.desc: 【文法】We look forward to ___ your innovative ideas at the upcoming seminar.
options: A. hear
B. hearing
C. be heard
D. heard
normal.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面必須接名詞或動名詞（V-ing）。

normal.desc:
【短文】Subject: Welcome! 
Dear Jane, 
We are excited to have you join our team. The mentor who will guide you during your first week is Mr. Davis. Please meet him at 9 AM tomorrow. 
Q: Who is Mr. Davis?
options: A. A new employee.
B. Jane's mentor.
C. The company's CEO.
D. A client.
normal.explain: 信中寫道「The mentor who will guide you... is Mr. Davis」，表示 Mr. Davis 是 Jane 的導師。

normal.desc: 【時態】They ___ the budget for next year when the power went out.
options: A. discuss
B. are discussing
C. have discussed
D. were discussing
normal.explain: 描述過去正在進行的動作（討論預算）被突發事件（停電 went out）打斷。

normal.desc: 【文法】The solar panels, ___ were installed last month, have significantly reduced our electricity bill.
options: A. that
B. which
C. what
D. they
normal.explain: 非限定用法的關係子句（由逗號隔開），修飾事物時只能用 which，不能用 that。

normal.desc: 【文法】Would you mind ___ the window? It's getting a bit cold in here.
options: A. closing
B. to close
C. close
D. closed
normal.explain: mind（介意）後面必須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】The tourist ___ luggage was lost at the airport filed a complaint immediately.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whose
D. whom
normal.explain: 此處表示「那位遊客的」行李，需使用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

normal.desc: 【時態】While the chef ___ the ingredients, the waiters were setting up the tables.
options: A. prepares
B. prepared
C. has prepared
D. was preparing
normal.explain: While 引導的子句常用進行式，且後方子句為 were setting up，表示過去同時正在發生的兩個動作。

normal.desc: 【文法】If you don't know how to use the equipment, you should avoid ___ it without supervision.
options: A. to operate
B. operate
C. operating
D. operated
normal.explain: avoid（避免）後方需接動名詞（V-ing）。

normal.desc: 【短文】Travel Blog: We spent three days exploring Kyoto. On the second day, while we were visiting a temple, it started to snow heavily. It was a magical experience. Q: What happened on their second day in Kyoto?
options: A. They arrived in Kyoto.
B. They got lost in a temple.
C. It snowed during their temple visit.
D. They decided to leave early.
normal.explain: 短文提到「while we were visiting a temple, it started to snow heavily」，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ to a podcast about remote work when I fell asleep.
options: A. am listening
B. was listening
C. listen
D. have listened
normal.explain: 表示在過去某時正在聽 podcast，接著發生了睡著（fell asleep）的動作。

normal.desc: 【文法】The itinerary ___ the travel agency provided was very detailed and helpful.
options: A. who
B. where
C. what
D. that
normal.explain: 先行詞是事物（itinerary），關係代名詞可用 that 或 which。

normal.desc: 【文法】She decided ___ a new career path after working in finance for ten years.
options: A. pursue
B. pursuing
C. to pursue
D. pursued
normal.explain: decide 後面必須接不定詞（to V）作受詞。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: Did you see the new intern? B: Yes, she is the one ___ was introduced at the morning meeting.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whose
D. whom
normal.explain: 先行詞 the one 指人（intern），在關係子句中作主詞，因此用 who。

normal.desc: 【時態】The CEO ___ a speech about sustainable development when the microphone stopped working.
options: A. gives
B. was giving
C. has given
D. gave
normal.explain: 過去某個持續進行的動作（正在演講）被另一個過去動作（麥克風壞掉）打斷，用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【短文】Environmental News: The government plans to implement a new policy that requires all supermarkets to charge for plastic bags. This aims to reduce plastic waste. Q: What is the purpose of the new policy?
options: A. To increase supermarket profits.
B. To promote the use of plastic bags.
C. To reduce plastic waste.
D. To close down local supermarkets.
normal.explain: 文中最後一句明確指出「This aims to reduce plastic waste」，也就是減少塑膠垃圾。

normal.desc: 【文法】I remember ___ this movie before; the ending is very surprising.
options: A. watch
B. to watch
C. watching
D. watched
normal.explain: remember V-ing 表示「記得曾經做過某事」；remember to V 是「記得要去做某事」。這裡指記得看過這部電影。

normal.desc: 【文法】The conference room, ___ is located on the second floor, can hold up to 50 people.
options: A. that
B. which
C. where
D. who
normal.explain: 有逗號隔開的非限定關係子句修飾事物（conference room）並作為主詞，只能用 which。

normal.desc: 【時態】While the engineers ___ the software, they found a critical bug in the system.
options: A. upgrade

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was watching the news when the phone rang.
options: A. 電話響的時候，我正在看新聞。
B. 我看完新聞後，打了一通電話。
C. 我在講電話的時候，剛好看到新聞。
D. 新聞播報結束時，電話響了。
normal.explain: 原句：I was watching the news when the phone rang. (電話響的時候，我正在看新聞。) 測試過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The woman who called earlier left a message.
options: A. 那位女士打電話來留言說會早點到。
B. 剛才打電話來的那位女士留了言。
C. 留言的那位女士打電話來取消了。
D. 請那位早點打來的女士留個言。
normal.explain: 原句：The woman who called earlier left a message. (剛才打電話來的那位女士留了言。) 測試關係代名詞 who。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you want to reschedule the appointment?
options: A. Yes, I paid for it yesterday.
B. No, the doctor is not here.
C. Yes, can we make it next Friday?
D. I have already read the schedule.
normal.explain: 原句：Do you want to reschedule the appointment? (你想要重新安排預約時間嗎？) 回答 C (可以改到下週五嗎？) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We are considering updating our software.
options: A. 我們已經更新了所有的軟體。
B. 我們正在考慮更新我們的軟體。
C. 我們不打算升級目前的系統。
D. 更新軟體需要很多時間考量。
normal.explain: 原句：We are considering updating our software. (我們正在考慮更新我們的軟體。) 測試 consider + V-ing。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The train that goes to the airport is arriving.
options: A. 來自機場的火車已經出發了。
B. 我們必須趕上前往機場的火車。
C. 前往機場的火車即將進站。
D. 這班火車不會開往機場。
normal.explain: 原句：The train that goes to the airport is arriving. (前往機場的火車即將進站。) 測試關係代名詞 that。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 他承認弄丟了收據。
B. 他答應會把收據找回來。
C. 他拒絕交出那張收據。
D. 他忘記把收據放在哪裡了。
normal.explain: 原句：He admitted losing the receipt. (他承認弄丟了收據。) 測試 admit + V-ing。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was waiting for the bus at that time.
options: A. 我那時候已經上公車了。
B. 我打算在那個時間等公車。
C. 我那時候正在等公車。
D. 公車在那個時候剛好抵達。
normal.explain: 原句：I was waiting for the bus at that time. (我那時候正在等公車。) 測試過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She promised to send the files by noon.
options: A. 她答應會在中午前寄出檔案。
B. 她希望能在中午前收到檔案。
C. 這些檔案保證會在中午前完成。
D. 她中午的時候正在寄送檔案。
normal.explain: 原句：She promised to send the files by noon. (她答應會在中午前寄出檔案。) 測試 promise to + V。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The doctor who treated you is unavailable today.
options: A. 你想看的醫生今天沒有上班。
B. 幫你治療的那位醫生今天沒空。
C. 醫生說你今天不需要來治療。
D. 今天那位醫生沒辦法幫你治療。
normal.explain: 原句：The doctor who treated you is unavailable today. (幫你治療的那位醫生今天沒空。) 測試關係代名詞 who。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Are you interested in joining our club?
options: A. No, I am not interesting.
B. Yes, I would love to learn more.
C. I joined the meeting yesterday.
D. The club is very expensive.
normal.explain: 原句：Are you interested in joining our club? (你有興趣加入我們的俱樂部嗎？) 回答 B 最恰當。測試 interested in + V-ing。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They were fixing the elevator all morning.
options: A. 他們整個早上都在修理電梯。

C. 他們打算明天早上修理電梯。
D. 電梯已經修理了一整個早上。
normal.explain: 原句：They were fixing the elevator all morning. (他們整個早上都在修理電梯。) 測試過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please remember to take your medicine.
options: A. 請記得你已經吃過藥了。
B. 請提醒我去拿藥。
C. 請記得要按時吃藥。
D. 我忘記把藥放在哪裡了。
normal.explain: 原句：Please remember to take your medicine. (請記得要吃藥。) 測試 remember to + V (記得要去做...)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I was wondering if you could help me with this presentation.
options: A. Yes, I was walking to the office.
B. Of course, what do you need?
C. I wonder why the presentation is late.
D. No, I didn't see the presentation.
normal.explain: 原句：I was wondering if you could help me with this presentation. (我在想你是否能幫我準備這份簡報。) 這是委婉的請求，回答 B (當然，你需要什麼？) 最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: What were you doing when the power went out?
options: A. I am going to buy some candles.
B. I was typing an email to a client.
C. The power will be back soon.
D. I went out for dinner yesterday.
normal.explain: 原句：What were you doing when the power went out? (停電的時候你正在做什麼？) 詢問過去某時間點的動作，回答 B (我正在打字發信給客戶) 最符合過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did you manage to find the meeting room?
options: A. The manager is in the meeting room.
B. Yes, it was right down the hall.
C. I will manage the project next week.
D. No, I am looking for a job.
normal.explain: 原句：Did you manage to find the meeting room? (你有順利找到會議室嗎？) 測試 manage to + V (設法完成)。回答 B (有，就在走廊盡頭) 最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The manager wants to know if we should proceed with the new campaign.
options: A. We are processing the refund now.
B. Tell him we need a few more days to decide.
C. The manager knows the answer.
D. Yes, the campaign was very successful.
normal.explain: 原句：The manager wants to know if we should proceed with the new campaign. (經理想知道我們是否該繼續進行新的活動。) 回答 B (告訴他我們還需要幾天決定) 邏輯正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you have any experience dealing with angry customers?
options: A. Yes, I am very angry right now.
B. No, the customer service is closed.
C. Yes, I worked in retail for three years.
D. I experience pain in my stomach.
normal.explain: 原句：Do you have any experience dealing with angry customers? (你有處理憤怒客人的經驗嗎？) 回答 C (有，我在零售業工作了三年) 展現相關經驗。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I forgot to bring the documents that you asked for.
options: A. 我忘記帶你要求的那些文件了。
B. 我已經把你要的文件帶來了。
C. 你忘記向我要求那些文件了。
D. 我忘了告訴你要帶那些文件。
normal.explain: 原句：I forgot to bring the documents that you asked for. (我忘記帶你要求的那些文件了。) 測試 forget to + V 與關係代名詞 that。

normal.desc: 【時態】The scientists ___ the effects of the new diet when the fire alarm rang.
options: A. analyze
B. were analyzing
C. have analyzed
D. will analyze
normal.explain: 這是一個測試「過去進行式」的句子，表示在過去某個特定時間點（火災警報響起時）正在進行的動作，因此選擇 B. were analyzing。其他選項時態不符。

normal.desc: 【文法】The recent study, ___ was published in a well-known medical journal, highlights the benefits of a balanced diet.
options: A. who
B. where
C. which
D. what
normal.explain: 逗號後的非限定用法，先行詞是事物 (The recent study)，必須使用關係代名詞 which。who 用於人，where 用於地方，what 不能當關係代名詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many doctors advise ___ up sugary drinks to improve heart health and lose weight.
options: A. to give
B. give
C. given
D. giving
normal.explain: 動詞 advise 後面若直接接動詞，需要使用動名詞 (V-ing) 形式，因此選 giving。to give 是不定詞，不符合用法。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: What were the researchers doing in the lab yesterday morning? B: They ___ the participants' blood pressure and heart rates.
options: A. were measuring
B. are measuring
C. measure
D. measured
normal.explain: 問句使用的是過去進行式 (were doing)，表示過去某段時間正在進行的事，故回答也應保持一致，使用 A. were measuring。其他時態錯誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】The local clinic plans ___ a free wellness program for seniors next month.
options: A. launching
B. to launch
C. launched
D. launch
normal.explain: 動詞 plan 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V)，表示計畫要做的事，因此正確答案為 B. to launch。A 是動名詞，不能接在 plan 後面。

normal.desc: 【文法】She admitted ___ the painkillers without consulting her family doctor first.
options: A. take
B. to take
C. taking
D. taken
normal.explain: 動詞 admit（承認）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 表示已經發生的動作，因此選 C. taking。to take 為不定詞，不合語法。

normal.desc: 【時態】The nurse ___ the patient's medical records when the hospital's computer system crashed.
options: A. updates
B. is updating
C. was updating
D. has updated
normal.explain: 句意表示當電腦系統當機的那一刻，護士「正在」更新病歷。過去的一個瞬間打斷了過去正在進行的動作，需用過去進行式，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】The new subway line, ___ connects the northern and southern districts, officially opens today.
options: A. which
B. who
C. where
D. what
normal.explain: 先行詞 The new subway line 是事物，且有逗號隔開作為補充說明，必須用關係代名詞 which。who 用於人，where 是關係副詞不當主詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】The mayor agreed ___ more bike lanes in the downtown area to reduce traffic jams.
options: A. construct
B. constructed
C. constructing
D. to construct
normal.explain: 動詞 agree 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V) 表示同意去做某事，因此選擇 D. to construct。constructing 動名詞錯誤。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ for the express train when I heard the station announcement.
options: A. wait
B. was waiting
C. am waiting
D. will wait
normal.explain: 表示在過去聽到廣播的瞬間，我「正在」等車，需使用過去進行式 B. was waiting。am waiting 是現在進行式，時態不對。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many citizens cannot tolerate ___ in heavy traffic for hours every morning.
options: A. sitting
B. to sit
C. sit
D. sat
normal.explain: 動詞 tolerate（容忍）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞，因此選 A. sitting。to sit 用法錯誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】Commuters ___ take the bus to work will see lower fares starting next month.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 先行詞 Commuters（通勤者）是人，且在關係子句中擔任主詞，必須使用關係代名詞 who。whom 是受格，which 用於事物。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: Why was the road blocked yesterday? B: Because the workers ___ the broken traffic lights.
options: A. fix
B. are fixing
C. were fixing
D. have fixed
normal.explain: 問句描述昨天的情況，回答說明當時正在進行的動作（修復紅綠燈），因此需要用過去進行式 C. were fixing。

normal.desc: 【文法】To save money and protect the environment, we decided ___ public transport instead of driving.
options: A. taking
B. take
C. took
D. to take
normal.explain: 動詞 decide 後面固定接不定詞 (to + V) 表示決定去做某事，因此選 D. to take。taking 不能接在 decide 後面。

normal.desc: 【文法】Before the big event, the speaker practiced ___ his speech in front of a mirror many times.
options: A. to deliver
B. deliver
C. delivering
D. delivered
normal.explain: 動詞 practice 後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 表示練習某事，故選 C. delivering。to deliver 是錯誤的搭配。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ an important email to a client when the power suddenly went out.
options: A. am drafting
B. was drafting
C. draft
D. have drafted
normal.explain: 「當電源突然中斷時，我『正在』起草電子郵件」，一個過去動作打斷了另一個過去正在進行的動作，需用過去進行式，選 B。

normal.desc: 【文法】During the meeting, she hesitated ___ the controversial issue because the boss was in a bad mood.
options: A. raising
B. raised
C. raise
D. to raise
normal.explain: 動詞 hesitate（猶豫）後面接不定詞 (to + V)，表示對做某事感到遲疑，因此正確答案為 D. to raise。

normal.desc: 【文法】The feedback ___ we received from the clients was very constructive and helpful.
options: A. that
B. who
C. what
D. whom

normal.desc: 【文法】The lantern festival, ___ celebrates the end of the lunar new year, lasts for several days.

C. where

normal.desc: 【時態】The traditional dancers ___ their routine when it suddenly started to pour rain.

normal.desc: 【文法】Tourists from all over the world travel to Taiwan ___ the famous sky lanterns.

B. seen
C. see

normal.desc: 【文法】Customers ___ leave a detailed review on our website will receive a 10% discount code.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose

normal.desc: 【時態】The driver ___ to music when he suddenly saw a dog crossing the street.

normal.explain: 原句：Drivers are advised to avoid the downtown area due to the marathon. 意思：由於馬拉松比賽，建議駕駛人避開市區。

normal.speak: I was wondering if you wanted to join us for a movie tonight.
options: A. 我想知道你今晚會不會去看電影

normal.speak: Thank you for the invitation to your graduation party.
options: A. 謝謝你來參加我的畢業派對

normal.speak: He swore to buy the tickets as soon as they go on sale.
options: A. 他保證買到的票會立刻拿去賣

normal.speak: What are you doing this weekend with your family?
options: A. 週末你要帶家人去哪裡玩？
B. 你的家人週末都在做什麼？

normal.explain: 原句：What are you doing this weekend with your family? 意思：你這個週末要和家人做什麼？

normal.desc: 【時態】The chef ___ the soup when the power suddenly went out.
options: A. was stirring
B. stirs
C. is stirring
D. has stirred
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：when 帶出的子句為過去簡單式（表示突發事件），主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作。因此選 A。

normal.desc: 【文法】We are looking for a reliable person ___ can lead the weekend charity event.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為 person（人），且在關係子句中作主詞，因此必須使用關係代名詞 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】The CEO decided ___ the launch date of the new product to ensure quality.
options: A. delaying
B. delay
C. to delay
D. delayed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：動詞 decide 後面固定接不定詞 (to V) 作為受詞，表示決定做某事。選 C 最符合文法。

normal.desc: 【時態】While I ___ the contract, I noticed a minor spelling mistake.
options: A. am reviewing
B. review
C. have reviewed
D. was reviewing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，且主要子句為過去式 (noticed)，故搭配過去進行式 was reviewing。

normal.desc: 【文法】The novel, ___ became a bestseller, is based on a true story.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞 The novel 是事物，非限定用法需要用 which 來補充說明該事物。

normal.desc: 【文法】Our department risks ___ our biggest client if we miss this chance.
options: A. lose
B. losing
C. to lose
D. lost
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：動詞 risk 後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，表示冒著做某事的風險。

normal.desc: 【時態】The technician ___ the server when the alarm sounded.
options: A. updates
B. is updating
C. was updating
D. to update
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：描述過去某個時間點正在發生的事，被另一個突發動作（警報響起）打斷，需使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】Please send the documents to the accountant ___ handles our tax returns.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞 accountant（會計師）為人，在關係子句中作主詞（負責處理），需用 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】Management cannot afford ___ bonuses this year due to low profits.
options: A. to pay
B. paying
C. pay
D. paid
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：afford 後方接動詞時，必須使用不定詞 (to V)，表示負擔得起去做某事。

normal.desc: 【時態】While the astronauts ___ the spacecraft, they lost connection with Earth.
options: A. operate
B. were operating
C. are operating
D. to operate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：背景事件發生在過去，While 引導的持續性動作需使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The software, ___ helps users track their expenses, is free to download.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. which
D. what
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為事物 (The software)，在非限定子句（有逗號隔開）中，只能使用 which 作為關係代名詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】She couldn't resist ___ a piece of chocolate cake after a long day at work.
options: A. eat
B. to eat
C. ate
D. eating
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：resist (抗拒) 後面必須搭配動名詞 (V-ing)，表示無法抗拒做某事。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ the quarterly financial report when you knocked on my door.
options: A. was writing
B. write
C. written
D. to write
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：敲門是過去的瞬間動作，在此之前已經開始且正在進行的動作要用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The candidate ___ we met yesterday has excellent communication skills.
options: A. which
B. that
C. what
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為人，在關係子句中作受詞，可用 whom 或 that（也可省略），選項中僅 that 符合。

normal.desc: 【文法】They aim ___ the construction of the new laboratory by next spring.
options: A. completing
B. completed
C. to complete
D. complete
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：動詞 aim (目標在於) 後方需接不定詞 (to V)，表示未來的企圖或目標。

normal.desc: 【時態】While the volunteers ___ the beach, they collected fifty bags of trash.
options: A. clean
B. to clean
C. are cleaning
D. were cleaning
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：過去進行的長動作 (cleaning) 配上過去發生的短動作或結論 (collected)，需用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The camera, ___ has a waterproof feature, is perfect for diving.
options: A. which
B. who
C. what
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為相機 (事物)，非限定關係子句中作為主詞，必須使用 which。

normal.desc: 【文法】He admitted ___ the confidential data to a competitor.
options: A. leak
B. leaking
C. to leak
D. leaked
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：admit (承認) 後面規定要接動名詞 (V-ing)，表示承認做過的事。

normal.desc: 【時態】The singer ___ performing on stage when the lights went out.
options: A. has
B. is
C. was
D. to be
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：停電 (went out) 是過去式，表示當時歌手「正在」表演，單數主詞搭配 was 形成過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】We need to hire an assistant ___ is fluent in both English and Japanese.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. what
D. who
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞是 assistant (人)，且為後面子句的主詞，必須使用關係代名詞 who。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't you answer my call? 
B: I ___ a shower when the phone rang.
options: A. was taking
B. take
C. taking
D. am taking
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：回答過去某個特定時間點正在進行的動作，使用過去進行式 (was taking)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is this the smartphone ___ everyone is talking about? 
B: Yes, its camera is amazing.
options: A. what
B. that
C. who
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞是事物 (smartphone)，關係代名詞可用 which 或 that，選項中只有 that 適用。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How did you fix the error? 
B: I simply stopped ___ the faulty code.
options: A. to use
B. used
C. using
D. use
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：stop V-ing 表示「停止做某事」，stop to V 則是「停下來去做另一件事」。此處語意為停止使用錯誤程式碼，選 using。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happened at the lab? 
B: We ___ the chemicals when the glass broke.
options: A. mix
B. are mixing
C. to mix
D. were mixing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：玻璃破裂 (broke) 是過去發生的瞬間，當時「我們正在混合化學物質」，故用過去進行式 were mixing。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Who is the woman over there? 
B: She is the scientist ___ won the Nobel Prize last year.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whose
D. whom
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞 scientist 是人，在關係子句中作主詞 (won 的發起者)，需使用 who。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are you going to the party? 
B: No, I can't justify ___ money on expensive tickets right now.
options: A. to spend
B. spending
C. spend
D. spent
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：justify (證明...是合理的) 後方接動詞時，通常搭配動名詞 (V-ing)，表示無法為花費找理由。

normal.desc: 【時態】The journalist ___ the celebrity when the celebrity suddenly got angry.
options: A. is interviewing
B. interview
C. was interviewing
D. to interview
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：突然生氣 (got angry) 為過去式突發事件，前面正在進行的採訪動作需用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】The new system, ___ takes effect on Monday, requires everyone to wear a badge.
options: A. what
B. who
C. whom
D. which
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為 system (事物)，在有逗號的非限定用法中只能使用 which 作為關係代名詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many startup founders struggle ___ funding during their first year of business.
options: A. to secure
B. securing
C. secure
D. secured
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：struggle to V 表示「努力/掙扎著去做某事」，需接不定詞。

normal.desc: 【時態】While the locals ___ the festival, a sudden thunderstorm ruined the decorations.
options: A. prepare
B. were preparing
C. preparing
D. are preparing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：背景動作發生在過去 (ruined 為過去式)，表示當地人當時正在準備，因此用過去進行式 were preparing。

normal.desc: 【文法】The museum guide ___ explained the history of the painting was very knowledgeable.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. who
D. what
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞為 guide (導遊/解說員)，是人且在子句中作主詞，必須填入 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】I don't recall ___ him at the charity gala last month.
options: A. meet
B. to meet
C. met
D. meeting
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：recall (回想起) 後方接動詞時，必須使用動名詞 (V-ing)，表示回想做過的事。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What was John doing at 8 PM? 
B: He ___ a movie with his family.
options: A. was watching
B. watch
C. watches
D. is watching
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：問句使用了過去進行式詢問過去特定時間正在做什麼，回答也應一致使用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Do you have the file ___ I sent you this morning? 
B: Yes, it is on my desktop.
options: A. what
B. that
C. who
D. whose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：先行詞是 file (事物)，關係代名詞可用 which 或 that，選項中只有 that 符合。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did she leave early? 
B: She intends ___ her daughter from school.
options: A. picking
B. pick
C. to pick
D. picked

C. to buy
D. bought
normal.explain: 動詞 hesitate（猶豫）後面必須接不定詞（to + V）當接受詞。(C) to buy 正確。(A) buying、(B) 原形動詞、(D) 過去式/過去分詞皆不符合文法規則。

normal.desc: 【文法】You must delay ___ the tags on the clothes if you want a full refund.
options: A. to remove
B. removed
C. remove
D. removing
normal.explain: 動詞 delay（延遲、暫緩）後面必須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。(D) removing 正確。(A) 不定詞、(B) 過去式/過去分詞、(C) 原形動詞皆無法接在 delay 之後。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't you complete the order?
B: I ___ my credit card details when the screen went black.
options: A. was entering
B. enters
C. have entered
D. to enter
normal.explain: 從 when the screen went black（螢幕變黑時）可知，對話描述的是過去某個突發事件發生當下「正在進行」的動作，須用過去進行式。(A) was entering 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The digital camera ___ I ordered last week finally came this morning.
options: A. who
B. which
C. where
D. what
normal.explain: 先行詞 The digital camera 為事物，引導關係子句且作為 ordered 的受詞應使用 which 或 that。(B) which 正確。(A) 用於人，(C) 用於地點副詞，(D) 不可有先行詞。

normal.desc:
【短文】Customer Review: I was tracking my package on the app when it suddenly showed 'delivered', but I received nothing. I had to contact support.
Q: What was the customer doing when the status changed?
options: A. She contacted support.
B. She received the package.
C. She was tracking the package.
D. She deleted the application.
normal.explain: 文中提到「I was tracking my package... when it suddenly showed 'delivered'」，由此可知狀態改變時，她正在追蹤包裹。(C) 與原文相符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Email: Dear Shopper, the discount code that you applied is only valid for footwear. Please remove the jacket from your cart to proceed.
Q: What is true about the discount code?
options: A. It is for footwear only.
B. It is for jackets.
C. It applies to all items.
D. It expired last week.
normal.explain: 信件中明確說明「the discount code... is only valid for footwear」（折扣碼僅適用於鞋類）。(A) 為正確敘述，其他選項皆與文意相悖。

normal.desc: 【時態】The athletes ___ in the gym when the fire alarm sounded.
options: A. trains
B. to train
C. were training
D. trained
normal.explain: when 子句為過去簡單式（sounded），表示過去發生的單一事件；主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的訓練。(C) were training 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】People ___ consume too much sugar face a higher risk of health issues.
options: A. whose
B. which
C. whom
D. who
normal.explain: 先行詞 People 為人，且在關係子句中擔任主詞（consume 的主詞），因此必須使用主格關係代名詞 who。(D) 正確。(A) 表所有格，(B) 用於事物，(C) 為受格。

normal.desc: 【文法】The coach favors ___ more vegetables and whole grains.
options: A. eating
B. to eat
C. ate
D. eat
normal.explain: 動詞 favor（偏好、贊同）在表示贊同某種行為時，通常接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。(A) eating 正確，符合文法與語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】He ___ heavily on the treadmill when he unexpectedly felt a sharp pain.
options: A. runs
B. was running
C. has run
D. run
normal.explain: when 引導過去簡單式（felt）的瞬間動作，主要子句則需使用過去進行式（was running）來描述當時持續在進行的跑步狀態。(B) 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The new vitamin supplement, ___ became popular recently, is actually ineffective.
options: A. who
B. where
C. which
D. whose
normal.explain: 這裡是非限定用法（有逗號），先行詞 The new vitamin supplement 是事物，故關係代名詞只能使用 which。(C) 正確。(A)、(D) 用於人，(B) 為地方副詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】You should try ___ portion sizes visually instead of weighing everything.
options: A. to estimate
B. estimate
C. estimated
D. estimating
normal.explain: try + V-ing 表示「嘗試（某方法/經驗）看是否有效果」，符合這裡「試著目測份量」的語境。(D) estimating 為正確答案。

normal.desc:
【短文】Fitness Blog: Yesterday, I was lifting weights when my trainer noticed my posture was wrong. He quickly corrected me before I got hurt.
Q: What happened while the writer was lifting weights?
options: A. The trainer noticed his wrong posture.
B. He dropped the weights on the floor.
C. He drank some water.
D. The fire alarm sounded.
normal.explain: 文中敘述「I was lifting weights when my trainer noticed my posture was wrong」，明確指出在他舉重時，教練注意到了他的姿勢錯誤。(A) 正確。

normal.desc: 【時態】The HR director ___ the benefits package when the projector turned off.
options: A. was explaining
B. explains
C. has explained
D. will explain
normal.explain: 配合 when 引導的過去突發事件（turned off），主要子句應使用過去進行式表示當時正在說明的動作。(A) was explaining 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The senior designer ___ sits next to the window will be your mentor.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 先行詞 The senior designer 為人，且在關係子句中作主詞（sits 的主詞），因此需使用主格關係代名詞 who。(B) 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】New staff members are instructed ___ this safety video by Friday.
options: A. watching
B. watch
C. to watch
D. watched
normal.explain: instruct sb. to do sth. 被動語態為 be instructed to do sth.（被指示去做某事）。因此空格應填入不定詞 to watch。(C) 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The strict company policy prohibits ___ sandals in the office.
options: A. to wear
B. wear
C. wore
D. wearing
normal.explain: 動詞 prohibit（禁止）若直接接動作作為受詞，需使用動名詞（V-ing）。因此 prohibition wearing sandals 是正確用法。(D) wearing 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The training manual, ___ contains all the security guidelines, is on your desk.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. where
normal.explain: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞 The training manual 為事物，必須使用關係代名詞 which 且在此作主詞。(A) 正確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Where was Mark during the orientation?
B: He ___ up his computer at his new desk.
options: A. set
B. was setting
C. to set
D. sets
normal.explain: 問句用 was 詢問過去特定時間（during the orientation）的狀態，回答時應使用過去進行式表達「他當時正在設定電腦」。(B) was setting 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Welcome Letter: We are thrilled to welcome you. Please do not forget to sign the privacy agreement before starting your tasks today.
Q: What must the new employee do before starting tasks?
options: A. Read the manual.
B. Watch a video.
C. Sign a privacy agreement.
D. Meet the mentor.
normal.explain: 信件中要求員工「sign the privacy agreement before starting your tasks today」（在開始工作前簽署隱私協議）。(C) 符合文意。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ along the river when the fireworks show began.
options: A. walk
B. to walk
C. were walking
D. walks
normal.explain: when 子句為過去簡單式（began），主要子句描述當時正在持續的動作，應使用過去進行式。(C) were walking 為唯一正確的時態。

normal.desc: 【文法】The historical temple ___ we visited yesterday was breathtaking.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. where
D. which
normal.explain: 先行詞 The historical temple 為事物，在關係子句中作 visited 的受詞，故使用 which 或 that。(D) which 正確。(C) where 為副詞不能當受詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many travelers fancy ___ local street food at the night market.
options: A. trying
B. try
C. to try
D. tried
normal.explain: 動詞 fancy（喜愛、想做）作為及物動詞時，後方須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。(A) trying 正確。(B) 原形、(C) 不定詞、(D) 過去式皆不合文法。

normal.desc: 【文法】The friendly local ___ gave us directions was very polite.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 先行詞 local 此處作名詞（當地人），代表「人」，且在關係子句中作主詞（gave 的主詞），因此要用 who。(B) 正確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How can we get to the island?
B: We prepared ___ a boat early in the morning.
options: A. renting
B. rent
C. to rent
D. rented
normal.explain: 動詞 prepare（準備）後方接另一個動詞時，需使用不定詞（to + V）表示目的或計畫的動作。(C) to rent 正確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the parade?
B: No, I ___ souvenir shopping when it passed by.
options: A. do
B. to do
C. did
D. was doing
normal.explain: when it passed by 是過去發生的瞬間動作，回答者表示遊行經過時，他「正在」買紀念品，需使用過去進行式。(D) was doing 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Travel Diary: It was the final day of the festival. We were watching the traditional dance performance when a wild dog ran onto the stage and made everyone laugh.
Q: What were they watching before the dog appeared?
options: A. A traditional dance performance.
B. A fireworks show.
C. The wild dog.
D. The night market.
normal.explain: 日記中提到「We were watching the traditional dance performance when a wild dog ran onto the stage」，說明野狗出現前他們正在看傳統舞蹈表演。(A) 正確。

normal.desc: 【時態】The battery indicator ___ red when the laptop completely shut down.
options: A. was flashing
B. flashes
C. to flash
D. has flashed
normal.explain: when 引導過去簡單式（shut down），表示過去事件，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示筆電關機當時指示燈「正在閃爍」。(A) 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The update ___ fixes the software bugs will be released tomorrow.
options: A. who
B. that
C. whom
D. where
normal.explain: 先行詞 The update 為事物，在關係子句中作主詞，關係代名詞需用 which 或 that。(B) that 正確。(A) who 用於人，(C) whom 為人的受格，皆不適用。

normal.desc: 【文法】___ the tablet to extreme heat will cause serious damage.
options: A. Expose
B. To exposing
C. Exposing
D. Exposed
normal.explain: 句子的主詞為一件事，故須以動名詞（V-ing）或不定詞作主詞。(C) Exposing（將平板暴露於極端高溫下）符合文法結構。(A) 為原形動詞，不能直接作主詞。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't the file save?
B: You ___ the application while it was still loading data.
options: A. close
B. closes
C. to close
D. were closing
normal.explain: 由 while it was still loading data（當它還在讀取資料時）可知背景時間在過去，且表示當時正在進行的動作，應配搭過去進行式。(D) were closing 正確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The wireless earphones, ___ offer noise cancellation, can pair with multiple devices.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. where
normal.explain: 逗號後的非限定關係子句用來補充說明 The wireless earphones（事物），因此必須使用關係代名詞 which。(A) 正確。(B) 與 (C) 用於人，(D) 用於地方。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the installation finished?
B: Not yet. The system seems ___ more time to download the necessary files.
options: A. needing
B. to need
C. need
D. needed
normal.explain: 連綴動詞 seem 後方若接動詞，必須使用不定詞（to + V）。因此 seems to need（似乎需要）是唯一正確用法。(B) 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】User Manual: After inserting the memory card, you have to format it before taking pictures. Otherwise, the camera might fail to save your images.
Q: What should users do after inserting the memory card?
options: A. Take a picture immediately.
B. Charge the battery.
C. Format the memory card.
D. Clean the lens.
normal.explain: 說明書中明確指示「you have to format it before taking pictures」（拍照前必須先將其格式化）。因此放入記憶卡後應進行格式化。(C) 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Warning Label: The cooling fan that is located at the back of the console should never be blocked. Overheating may cause permanent damage.
Q: What should not be blocked?
options: A. The memory card.
B. The touch screen.
C. The USB cable.
D. The cooling fan.
normal.explain: 警告標籤上提到「The cooling fan... should never be blocked」（散熱風扇絕對不可被擋住）。因此正確答案為 (D)。

normal.speak: Could you clarify what you mean by that last point?
options: A. 你能把最後一點刪除嗎？
B. 你能澄清你最後那一點的意思嗎？
C. 你能把最後一點寫下來嗎？
D. 你能重複第一點嗎？
normal.explain: 原句意為「你能澄清你最後那一點的意思嗎？」。clarify 意思是「澄清、說明」的意思。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was pressing the mute button when you called my name.
options: A. 當你叫我的名字時，我正在找耳機。
B. 當你叫我的名字時，我已經關掉電腦了。
C. 當你叫我的名字時，我正在按靜音按鈕。
D. 當你叫我的名字時，我正在大聲說話。
normal.explain: 原句：I was pressing the mute button when you called my name.（當你叫我的名字時，我正在按靜音按鈕。）使用了過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you mind sharing your screen so we can all see the document?
options: A. Not at all. Give me a second.
B. I was watching a movie.
C. The screen is broken.
D. He forgot to bring the document.
normal.explain: 原句：Do you mind sharing your screen so we can all see the document?（你介意分享螢幕好讓我們都能看到文件嗎？）回答「Not at all. Give me a second.」（一點也不介意，給我一秒鐘）最自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The book that I borrowed last month is now overdue.
options: A. 我上個月借的書不見了。
B. 我上個月借的書現在逾期了。
C. 我上個月買的書很貴。
D. 我上個月讀的書很有趣。
normal.explain: 原句意為「我上個月借的書現在逾期了」。overdue 意指「逾期的」，that 引導關係子句修飾書。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The sculpture which stands in the hall is extremely valuable.
options: A. 放在大廳的那幅畫非常昂貴。
B. 站在大廳的那個人非常有名。
C. 放在大廳的那個雕塑非常有價值。
D. 大廳裡的那個雕塑是假的。
normal.explain: 原句：The sculpture which stands in the hall is extremely valuable.（放在大廳的那個雕塑非常有價值。）which 引導關係子句，sculpture 為雕塑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I am planning to visit the history museum this weekend.
options: A. I enjoy painting walls.
B. The museum closed a year ago.
C. That sounds great. Who are you going with?
D. You should avoid eating too much.
normal.explain: 原句：I am planning to visit the history museum this weekend.（我打算這個週末去參觀歷史博物館。）回應 C「聽起來很棒，你要跟誰去？」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I would like to deposit this check into my savings account.
options: A. 我想從我的儲蓄帳戶提款。
B. 我想開一個新的銀行帳戶。
C. 我想把這張支票存入我的儲蓄帳戶。
D. 我想把這張支票換成現金。
normal.explain: 原句意為「我想把這張支票存入我的儲蓄帳戶」。deposit 在此作動詞，意為「存款、存入」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was filling out the forms when the bank clerk called my number.
options: A. 當銀行職員叫到我的號碼時，我正在講電話。
B. 當銀行職員叫到我的號碼時，我正在填寫表格。
C. 當銀行職員叫到我的號碼時，我正在排隊。
D. 當銀行職員叫到我的號碼時，我剛離開銀行。
normal.explain: 原句：I was filling out the forms when the bank clerk called my number.（當銀行職員叫到我的號碼時，我正在填寫表格。）使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Could you tell me how to withdraw money from this ATM?
options: A. The bank is closed on Sundays.
B. Sure, just insert your card here first.
C. I forgot to bring my passport.
D. I want to buy some stamps.
normal.explain: 原句：Could you tell me how to withdraw money from this ATM?（你能告訴我如何從這台自動提款機提款嗎？）回應 B「當然，先在這裡插入你的卡片」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You need to take this prescription to the pharmacy right away.
options: A. 你需要立刻把這個包裹送到郵局。
B. 你需要立刻去見醫生。
C. 你需要立刻吃藥。
D. 你需要立刻把這張處方箋拿去藥局。
normal.explain: 原句意為「你需要立刻把這張處方箋拿去藥局」。prescription 指的是醫生的「處方箋」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The specialist who treated my back pain works at this clinic.
options: A. 治療我背痛的專科醫生在這間診所工作。
B. 這間診所沒有治療背痛的醫生。
C. 治療我背痛的醫生今天請假。
D. 這間診所的護士非常專業。
normal.explain: 原句：The specialist who treated my back pain works at this clinic.（治療我背痛的專科醫生在這間診所工作。）who 引導關係子句修飾 specialist（專科醫生）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did the doctor suggest taking any painkillers for your headache?
options: A. Yes, he told me to take one every six hours.
B. I am looking for the hospital.
C. He was washing his hands.
D. No, she is a dentist.
normal.explain: 原句：Did the doctor suggest taking any painkillers for your headache?（醫生有建議吃任何止痛藥來緩解你的頭痛嗎？）回應 A「有，他叫我每六小時吃一顆」最正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was feeling completely exhausted after working all weekend.
options: A. 整個週末工作後，我感到非常興奮。
B. 整個週末工作後，我感到筋疲力盡。
C. 我整個週末都在休息。
D. 我週末完全忘記要工作。
normal.explain: 原句意為「整個週末工作後，我感到筋疲力盡」。exhausted 意思是「筋疲力盡的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The story that she told us about her camping trip was hilarious.
options: A. 她告訴我們關於她露營旅行的故事非常可怕。
B. 她告訴我們關於她露營旅行的故事非常無聊。
C. 她告訴我們關於她露營旅行的故事非常搞笑。
D. 她告訴我們關於她露營旅行的故事很悲傷。
normal.explain: 原句：The story that she told us about her camping trip was hilarious.（她告訴我們關於她露營旅行的故事非常搞笑。）hilarious 是極度好笑的意思。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We were having a barbecue in the backyard when it started raining.
options: A. You should wear a jacket.
B. Oh no, what did you do then?
C. The barbecue is delicious.
D. I was taking a shower.
normal.explain: 原句：We were having a barbecue in the backyard when it started raining.（我們正在後院烤肉時，開始下雨了。）回應 B「噢不，那你們後來怎麼辦？」最自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please ensure that your microphone is off to avoid background noise.
options: A. 請確保你的麥克風是開著的，以免有背景噪音。
B. 請確保你的耳機有戴好，以免聽不到聲音。
C. 請確保你的麥克風是關閉的，以避免背景噪音。
D. 請確保你的螢幕是開啟的，以避免干擾。
normal.explain: 原句意為「請確保你的麥克風是關閉的，以避免背景噪音」。avoid 後面可接名詞，background noise 為背景噪音。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The woman who is speaking right now is our new marketing director.
options: A. 剛才說話的那個女人是我們的舊行銷總監。
B. 正在說話的那個女人是我們的新行銷總監。
C. 正在說話的那個男人是我們的新行銷總監。
D. 正在聽話的那個女人是我們的行銷助理。
normal.explain: 原句：The woman who is speaking right now is our new marketing director.（正在說話的那個女人是我們的新行銷總監。）who 引導關係子句修飾 woman。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I regret missing the first part of the meeting. What did they talk about?
options: A. They are reading a book.
B. I forgot my notebook at home.
C. They mostly went over the new sales targets.
D. You need to finish the project tonight.
normal.explain: 原句：I regret missing the first part of the meeting. What did they talk about?（我很後悔錯過了會議的前半段。他們談了什麼？）回應 C「他們主要討論了新的銷售目標」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Eating or drinking is strictly prohibited inside the art gallery.
options: A. 藝廊內禁止拍照。
B. 藝廊內嚴格禁止飲食。
C. 藝廊內嚴格禁止喧嘩。
D. 藝廊內允許吃零食。
normal.explain: 原句意為「藝廊內嚴格禁止飲食」。prohibited 意為「被禁止的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I remember seeing that famous painting when I was traveling in France.
options: A. 我記得在法國旅行時看過那幅著名的畫。
B. 我忘記在法國旅行時有看過那幅畫。
C. 我記得在法國買過那幅畫。
D. 我計畫去法國看那幅著名的畫。
normal.explain: 原句：I remember seeing that famous painting when I was traveling in France.（我記得在法國旅行時看過那幅著名的畫。）remember + V-ing 表示記得做過某事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you know if the library charges a fee for overdue items?
options: A. Yes, it is fifty cents per day.
B. The library is closed on Mondays.
C. I am reading a novel.
D. You can borrow up to five books.
normal.explain: 原句：Do you know if the library charges a fee for overdue items?（你知道圖書館對逾期歸還的物品會收費嗎？）回答 A「會，每天五十美分」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The parcel which you sent on Monday hasn't been delivered yet.
options: A. 你星期一寄的包裹已經送達了。
B. 你星期一寄的包裹還沒送達。
C. 你星期一收到的包裹不見了。
D. 你星期一買的包裹很重。
normal.explain: 原句意為「你星期一寄的包裹還沒送達」。parcel 是包裹，which 引導關係子句修飾它。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She was putting a stamp on the envelope when she realized it was empty.
options: A. 她正在把信件放進信封時，發現郵票不見了。
B. 她正在信封上貼郵票時，才發現裡面是空的。
C. 她正在買信封時，才發現自己沒帶錢。
D. 她正在寫信時，才發現筆沒水了。
normal.explain: 原句：She was putting a stamp on the envelope when she realized it was empty.（她正在信封上貼郵票時，才發現裡面是空的。）使用了過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I am thinking about applying for a loan to buy a new car.
options: A. I like driving on the highway.
B. That sounds like a big decision. Have you checked the interest rates?
C. The bank teller was very polite.
D. You should lock the door.
normal.explain: 原句：I am thinking about applying for a loan to buy a new car.（我在考慮申請貸款買新車。）回應 B「聽起來是個重大決定，你查過利率了嗎？」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please describe the symptoms that you have been experiencing.
options: A. 請描述你正在服用的藥物。
B. 請描述你經歷過的症狀。
C. 請描述你的病史。
D. 請描述你昨天吃了什麼。
normal.explain: 原句意為「請描述你一直經歷的症狀」。symptoms 是「症狀」的意思。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted forgetting to take his blood pressure medicine this morning.
options: A. 他承認今天早上忘記吃血壓藥。
B. 他否認今天早上忘記吃血壓藥。
C. 他承認今天早上把血壓藥弄丟了。
D. 他記得今天早上有吃血壓藥。
normal.explain: 原句：He admitted forgetting to take his blood pressure medicine this morning.（他承認今天早上忘記吃血壓藥。）admit + V-ing 表示承認做過某事，forget to V 表示忘記去做。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Are you allergic to any specific kind of antibiotics?
options: A. No, I am not allergic to any medication.
B. I was taking a nap.
C. The pharmacy is closed right now.
D. Yes, I enjoy eating seafood.
normal.explain: 原句：Are you allergic to any specific kind of antibiotics?（你對任何特定種類的抗生素過敏嗎？）回應 A「沒有，我對任何藥物都不過敏」最符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We ended up chatting at the coffee shop for three hours.
options: A. 我們在咖啡廳吵了三個小時。
B. 我們最後在咖啡廳聊了三個小時。
C. 我們在咖啡廳等了三個小時。
D. 我們打算在咖啡廳聊三個小時。
normal.explain: 原句意為「我們最後在咖啡廳聊了三個小時」。end up + V-ing 表示「最後結果是...」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was listening to a podcast when I fell asleep on the sofa.
options: A. 當我在沙發上睡著時，我正在看電視。
B. 當我在沙發上睡著時，我正在聽播客。
C. 當我在床上睡著時，我正在聽播客。
D. 當我正在聽音樂時，有人敲門。
normal.explain: 原句：I was listening to a podcast when I fell asleep on the sofa.（當我在沙發上睡著時，我正在聽播客。）為過去進行式與簡單過去式的結合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did you manage to fix the broken bicycle over the weekend?
options: A. The bicycle is very expensive.
B. I bought it last year.
C. Yes, it took me a few hours, but it works fine now.
D. I prefer driving a car.
normal.explain: 原句：Did you manage to fix the broken bicycle over the weekend?（你週末有成功修好那輛壞掉的腳踏車嗎？）回應 C「有，花了我幾個小時，但現在沒問題了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The connection seems unstable, so you are cutting out a bit.
options: A. 連線似乎不穩定，所以你的聲音有點斷斷續續。
B. 連線非常穩定，所以我們聽得很清楚。
C. 螢幕似乎有問題，所以畫面有點模糊。
D. 你切斷了連線，所以我們聽不到。
normal.explain: 原句意為「連線似乎不穩定，所以你的聲音有點斷斷續續」。cutting out 在此指通話時聲音斷斷續續。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Anyone who wishes to speak should raise their virtual hand.
options: A. 任何不想說話的人都應該舉手。
B. 任何希望發言的人都應該舉起他們的虛擬手。
C. 任何人都可以隨時發言，不需要舉手。
D. 發言前必須先關閉麥克風。
normal.explain: 原句：Anyone who wishes to speak should raise their virtual hand.（任何希望發言的人都應該舉起他們的虛擬手。）who 引導關係子句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I am sorry for interrupting, but could you go back to the previous slide?
options: A. Sure, let me pull it up again.
B. The slide is very colorful.
C. I didn't see the movie.
D. You should apologize to him.
normal.explain: 原句：I am sorry for interrupting, but could you go back to the previous slide?（很抱歉打斷你，但你能回到上一張投影片嗎？）回應 A「沒問題，讓我再把它拉出來」最為得體。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The catalogue contains all the artworks that are on display.
options: A. 這本目錄包含所有展出的藝術品。
B. 這本目錄包含所有博物館的歷史。
C. 這些藝術品都沒有收錄在目錄中。
D. 這本目錄只能在禮品店買到。
normal.explain: 原句意為「這本目錄包含所有展出的藝術品」。that 引導關係子句修飾 artworks。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We were admiring the ancient artifacts when the guide started speaking.
options: A. 當導遊開始說話時，我們正在拍照。
B. 當導遊開始說話時，我們正在欣賞古代文物。
C. 當導遊開始說話時，我們正在離開博物館。
D. 當導遊開始說話時，我們正在買紀念品。
normal.explain: 原句：We were admiring the ancient artifacts when the guide started speaking.（當導遊開始說話時，我們正在欣賞古代文物。）使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Would you mind keeping your voice down in the reading area?
options: A. Yes, I love reading books.
B. Oh, I apologize. I didn't realize I was being loud.
C. The reading area is on the second floor.
D. You should turn up the volume.
normal.explain: 原句：Would you mind keeping your voice down in the reading area?（你介意在閱讀區放低音量嗎？）回應 B「噢，我道歉，我沒意識到我太大聲了」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please ensure you sign the document before leaving the counter.
options: A. 請確保在離開櫃檯前簽署文件。
B. 請確保在離開櫃檯前拿走收據。
C. 請確保在離開前將文件交給經理。
D. 請確保在離開櫃檯前數清零錢。
normal.explain: 原句意為「請確保在離開櫃檯前簽署文件」。ensure 意指「確保」，sign 是「簽名」。

normal.desc: 【文法】The solar panels ___ we set up last month have reduced our electricity bill.
options: A. which
B. who
C. what
D. whose
normal.explain: 【文法】先行詞為事物（solar panels 太陽能板），應使用關係代名詞 which 或是 that。who 用於人，what 不能當關係代名詞，whose 為所有格，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many cities plan ___ single-use plastic bags by next year.
options: A. ban
B. to ban
C. banning
D. banned
normal.explain: 【文法】動詞 plan 後面必須接不定詞（to V）表示「計畫做某事」。故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】The volunteers ___ trees in the park when it started raining heavily.
options: A. plant
B. planted
C. were planting
D. have planted
normal.explain: 【時態】when 引導的子句表示過去某個發生的時間點，主要子句應使用過去進行式表示「當時正在進行的動作」。主詞為複數，故選 C (were planting)。

normal.desc: 【文法】Instead of driving to work, she chose ___ a bicycle to reduce carbon emissions.
options: A. ride
B. rode
C. riding
D. to ride
normal.explain: 【文法】動詞 choose（過去式為 chose）後方需接不定詞（to V）表示「選擇去做某事」。故選 D。

normal.desc: 【文法】The activist ___ spoke at the climate summit urged leaders to take immediate action.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 【文法】先行詞 The activist（行動主義者）為人，且在關係子句中作主詞（spoke 的發出者），應使用主格關係代名詞 who。故選 A。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the documentary on ocean pollution?
B: Yes, I ___ it while I was having dinner.
options: A. watch
B. was watching
C. have watched
D. will watch
normal.explain: 【時態】while 引導的過去進行式子句 (while I was having dinner) 通常搭配另一個過去進行式，表示過去兩個動作同時正在發生。故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】News Report: While workers were cleaning up the oil spill on the coast, they discovered a rare species of turtle. The turtle was safely relocated to a marine center.
Q: What were the workers doing when they found the turtle?
options: A. They were swimming in the sea.
B. They were removing oil from the coast.
C. They were feeding marine animals.
D. They were testing the water quality.
normal.explain: 【閱讀】短文提到「While workers were cleaning up the oil spill... (當工人們正在清理漏油時)」，cleaning up the oil spill 意思等同於 B 選項的 removing oil。故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ a virtual meeting when my internet connection unexpectedly dropped.
options: A. am attending
B. attended
C. was attending
D. have attended
normal.explain: 【時態】when my internet connection dropped 是過去發生的單一事件，當時「我」正在進行某個動作，應使用過去進行式。故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】The productivity software ___ we use allows us to collaborate in real-time.
options: A. who
B. where
C. whom
D. that
normal.explain: 【文法】先行詞為事物（software），關係代名詞可使用 which 或 that。其他選項 who/whom 用於人，where 用於地方。故選 D。

normal.desc: 【文法】The company allows employees ___ flexible hours as long as they complete their tasks.
options: A. to choose
B. choosing
C. choose
D. chose
normal.explain: 【文法】allow 的用法是 allow someone to do something（允許某人做某事），後方必須接不定詞 (to V)。故選 A。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did Mark miss the morning briefing?
B: He ___ his laptop system when the briefing started.
options: A. updates
B. was updating
C. has updated
D. will update
normal.explain: 【時態】當簡報開始時（過去時間點），馬克「正在」更新他的電腦系統，所以錯過了簡報。應使用過去進行式。故選 B。

normal.desc: 【文法】The team leader ___ guides the remote team always ensures everyone feels included.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 【文法】先行詞為人 (team leader)，且在關係子句中作為主詞 (發出 guide 的動作)，應使用主格關係代名詞 who。故選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文】Business Article: Co-working spaces, which offer high-speed internet and quiet areas, are becoming extremely popular among freelancers.
Q: What is an advantage of co-working spaces mentioned in the article?
options: A. Free coffee and snacks.
B. Fast internet connections.
C. Free laptop rentals.
D. Long-term housing.
normal.explain: 【閱讀】短文中提到 shared spaces 提供 high-speed internet (高速網路) 以及安靜的區域，這對應到 B 選項的 Fast internet connections。故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Workplace Survey: A recent poll indicates that most professionals intend to continue working from home at least twice a week.
Q: What do most professionals plan to do?
options: A. Return to the office full-time.
B. Quit their current jobs.
C. Buy new home office equipment.
D. Work remotely a few days a week.
normal.explain: 【閱讀】文章提到多數專業人士打算 (intend to) 每週至少有兩天在家工作，符合 D 選項「一週有幾天遠距工作」的意思。故選 D。

normal.desc: 【文法】The marathon runner ___ broke the world record trained for over ten years.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whom
D. where
normal.explain: 【文法】先行詞為人 (runner)，在子句中作主詞 (打破紀錄的人)，應填入主格關係代名詞 who。故選 A。

normal.desc: 【時態】The referee ___ the players closely when the foul occurred.
options: A. watches
B. was watching
C. watched
D. has watched
normal.explain: 【時態】when the foul occurred 表示過去發生的犯規事件，當時裁判「正在」密切注視著球員，需用過去進行式。故選 B。

normal.desc: 【文法】After the heavy rain, the committee postponed ___ the final tennis match until the next day.
options: A. hold
B. to hold
C. holding
D. held
normal.explain: 【文法】postpone（延期）後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，表示延遲做某事。故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】The stadium, ___ can hold fifty thousand fans, was completely sold out for the final.
options: A. who
B. where
C. that
D. which
normal.explain: 【文法】有逗號的非限定用法，先行詞為事物 (stadium) 時只能用 which，不能用 that 代替。故選 D。

normal.desc: 【文法】The young gymnast hopes ___ a gold medal at the upcoming international championship.
options: A. to win
B. winning

normal.desc: 【文法】The famous food critic did not mind ___ in line for two hours to try the new ramen.

B. to wait

normal.desc: 【時態】The chef ___ a special sauce when the kitchen caught fire.

B. prepared
C. has prepared
D. was preparing

normal.desc: 【文法】The restaurant ___ serves authentic Mexican cuisine is located downtown.

B. who

normal.speak: I was sweeping the floor when the glass broke.
options: A. 我正在擦桌子時水杯倒了。
