normal.explain: I was sweeping the floor when the glass broke.（我正在掃地時玻璃破了。）

normal.desc: 【時態】The security guard ___ the exhibition when the lights went out.
options: A. was patrolling
B. patrols
C. has patrolled
D. will patrol
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。句中的 when 帶出過去發生的瞬間動作（燈光熄滅），而在此之前就已經在進行且持續的動作（巡邏），必須使用過去進行式 (was/were + V-ing)。選項 B 為現在單純式，選項 C 為現在完成式，選項 D 為未來式，皆不符合過去的時間背景。

normal.desc: 【文法】The ancient sculpture ___ was stolen last year has been found.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 The ancient sculpture（古代雕塑品）為事物，因此關係代名詞應使用 which 或 that，在子句中作主詞。who 和 whom 用於人，whose 用於表示所有格，皆不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【文法】The resident enjoys ___ flowers on her small balcony.
options: A. plant
B. to plant
C. planting
D. planted
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞的用法。動詞 enjoy（喜愛、享受）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞，表示喜歡做某件事。因此選項 C 的 planting 為正確答案。其他選項的形態皆不符合文法規定。

normal.desc: 【文法】He decided ___ an apartment in the commercial district.
options: A. rent
B. renting
C. rents
D. to rent
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞的用法。動詞 decide（決定）後面必須接不定詞 (to + 原形動詞) 當作受詞。因此選項 D 的 to rent 是唯一正確的用法。

normal.desc: 【時態】She ___ a meditation podcast when she fell asleep.
options: A. was listening to
B. is listening to
C. listens to
D. listen to
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。句尾的 when she fell asleep 指出這是在過去發生的瞬間事件，而在這瞬間之前正在持續進行的動作（聽冥想廣播）需要用過去進行式 (was/were + V-ing)。

normal.desc: 【文法】The therapist ___ helped me with my anxiety is very professional.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 The therapist（治療師）是人，且在關係子句中扮演主詞（幫助我），因此必須使用 who。whom 為受格，whose 為所有格，which 用於事物，皆不適用。

normal.desc: 【文法】You should avoid ___ suspicious links in unknown emails.
options: A. click
B. to click
C. clicking
D. clicked
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。動詞 avoid（避免）後面固定接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞。因此正確答案為 clicking。選項 B 的不定詞與 avoid 的文法不合。

normal.desc: 【文法】The hacker attempted ___ the company's financial data.
options: A. steal
B. stealing
C. stole
D. to steal
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。動詞 attempt（試圖、企圖）後面通常接不定詞 (to + 原形動詞) 作為受詞，表示企圖做某事。因此 D 為正確選項。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ food at the shelter when the mayor arrived.
options: A. were distributing
B. distribute
C. have distributed
D. will distribute
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。when the mayor arrived 為過去發生的時間點，當時正在進行的動作（分發食物）需使用過去進行式。主詞為 We，故動詞搭配 were distributing。

normal.desc: 【文法】The campaign ___ raised millions for orphans was a huge success.
options: A. who
B. that
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 The campaign（活動）為事物，關代應使用 which 或 that。選項中只有 that 符合條件。who 和 whom 用於人，whose 用於所有格。

normal.desc: 【文法】The guide suggested ___ the museum during the early morning.
options: A. visit
B. to visit
C. visiting
D. visited
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。suggest（建議）後面如果直接接動詞，必須使用動名詞 (V-ing) 形態。因此正確答案為 visiting，不可以使用不定詞 to visit。

normal.desc: 【文法】They plan ___ the historic monument to attract more tourists.
options: A. preserve
B. preserving
C. preserves
D. to preserve
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。plan（計畫）做某事，後面必須接不定詞 (to + 原形動詞)。因此選項 D 的 to preserve 是唯一正確的搭配。

normal.desc: 【時態】The landlord ___ the property when he noticed the broken window.
options: A. was checking
B. checks
C. checked
D. has checked
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。noticed 為過去簡單式，表示瞬間發現。在發現窗戶破掉時，房東「正在」檢查房產，這個持續的動作需要用過去進行式 (was checking)。

normal.desc: 【文法】The tenant ___ lives upstairs often plays loud music at night.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 tenant（租客）是人，且在關係子句中作主詞（住在樓上），必須使用 who。whom 為受格，which 用於事物，whose 為所有格。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many doctors recommend ___ a regular sleep routine for better health.
options: A. establish
B. to establish
C. establishing
D. established
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。動詞 recommend（推薦、建議）與 suggest 類似，後方若直接接受詞，須使用動名詞 (V-ing)。故選 establishing。

normal.desc: 【文法】It is crucial ___ your screen time before going to bed.
options: A. reduce
B. reducing
C. reduces
D. to reduce
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞當虛主詞的真主詞。句型 It is + 形容詞 + to V，用不定詞片語 (to reduce...) 來表示真正的主詞（減少螢幕時間是至關重要的）。

normal.desc: 【時態】The employee ___ an attachment when the virus warning popped up.
options: A. was downloading
B. downloads
C. has downloaded
D. download
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。當病毒警告跳出來 (popped up) 的瞬間，員工「正在」下載附件，持續的動作必須用過去進行式 was downloading。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you freeze your credit card? 
B: Yes, the bank advised me ___ the card after a fraud alert.
options: A. freeze
B. to freeze
C. freezing
D. froze
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。動詞 advise 的用法為 advise + 受詞 + to V，表示「建議某人做某事」。因此必須選擇 to freeze。不能直接加原形動詞或 V-ing。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you join the fundraiser? 
B: No, I ___ the kids at the orphanage when it started.
options: A. am tutoring
B. have tutored
C. was tutoring
D. tutor
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。when it started 表示募款活動開始的過去時間點。當時說話者「正在」孤兒院教小孩，因此要用過去進行式 (was tutoring)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you met the new volunteer? 
B: Yes, she is the person ___ organized the charity run last month.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 the person 是人，且在關係子句中作主詞 (organized)，必須使用主格關係代名詞 who。which 用於物，whom 為受格，whose 為所有格。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What did you think of the gallery? 
B: I really enjoyed ___ the contemporary artworks on the second floor.
options: A. viewing
B. to view
C. view
D. viewed
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。動詞 enjoy 後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞，表示享受做某件事的過程。因此 viewing 是正確選項。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why was the artifact removed? 
B: The curator wanted ___ it from the intense sunlight.
options: A. protect
B. to protect
C. protecting
D. protected
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。want 後面接動作時，必須使用不定詞 (to V)，表示「想要做某事」。因此選 to protect。不能使用動名詞 protecting。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Where were you at 8 PM? 
B: I ___ my rent with the landlord in the lobby.
options: A. discuss
B. have discussed
C. was discussing
D. will discuss
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。問句詢問昨晚 8 點（過去特定時間點）在做什麼，回答當時正在進行的動作需使用過去進行式 was discussing。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is this the apartment ___ you mentioned? 
B: Yes, it has a beautiful balcony facing the park.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. whose
D. that
normal.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 apartment（公寓）為事物，因此必須使用 which 或 that。選項中只有 that 適用。who, whom, whose 皆用於指人或人的所有格。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: I can't seem to focus during the day. 
B: You should consider ___ more sleep to avoid chronic fatigue.
options: A. getting
B. to get
C. get
D. gotten
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。動詞 consider（考慮）後面如果接動詞，必須使用動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞。因此選 getting。不定詞 to get 不符合文法。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How do you handle stress? 
B: I practice ___ deep breathing exercises every morning.
options: A. to do
B. doing
C. do
D. done
normal.explain: 本題測驗動名詞。動詞 practice（練習、實踐）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞。因此正確答案為 doing。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Was the email a scam? 
B: Yes, the sender ___ to deceive me when I noticed the fake logo.
options: A. tries
B. has tried
C. was trying
D. try
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。when I noticed... 表示過去發現假標誌的瞬間，當時對方「正在試圖」欺騙，需使用過去進行式 was trying。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How can we protect our accounts? 
B: The IT department requires everyone ___ complex passwords regularly.
options: A. updating
B. update
C. updated
D. to update
normal.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。require 的句型為 require + 受詞 + to V（要求某人做某事）。因此必須選不定詞 to update。

normal.desc:
【短文】Charity Newsletter: We are looking for people who can help at the animal shelter. Volunteers will be responsible for walking the dogs and cleaning the cages.
Q: What will the volunteers do?
options: A. Walk the dogs
B. Buy dog food
C. Train the cats
D. Build new cages
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。短文中明確提到志工的責任是「遛狗 (walking the dogs)」和「清理籠子」。因此選項 A 是正確答案。其他選項短文中並未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文】Museum Notice: The ancient vase that was displayed in the main hall has been moved to a secure room for restoration.
Q: Why was the vase moved?
options: A. It was sold
B. It needed to be repaired
C. It was stolen
D. It was too heavy
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解與字彙。短文指出花瓶被移到安全房間是為了「restoration (修復)」。修復的意思等同於 repair (修理)，因此選項 B 為正確答案。

normal.desc:
【短文】City Bulletin: The new commercial district, which includes a shopping mall and an office building, will open next spring. It aims to create more local jobs.
Q: What is the goal of the new district?
options: A. To build more apartments
B. To reduce traffic
C. To provide employment
D. To close old shops
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。短文最後一句提到 "It aims to create more local jobs"（目標是創造更多在地工作機會），等同於 provide employment（提供就業），故選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Health Article: People who suffer from depression often experience poor sleep. Doctors suggest engaging in light exercise to improve overall mental health.
Q: What do doctors recommend for better mental health?
options: A. Taking more medicine
B. Sleeping all day
C. Ignoring the problem
D. Doing light exercise
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。短文中說「Doctors suggest engaging in light exercise」（醫生建議從事輕度運動）。因此選項 D 完全符合文意。

normal.desc:
【短文】Security Warning: Never share your password with anyone. Yesterday, a hacker was attempting to steal user data when our system blocked the attack.
Q: What happened yesterday?
options: A. An attack was stopped
B. Data was lost completely
C. The system crashed
D. Passwords were changed
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中提到當駭客企圖竊取資料時，「our system blocked the attack (我們的系統擋下了攻擊)」。這表示攻擊被阻止了 (An attack was stopped)，故選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】Volunteer Diary: I was packing donation boxes when the coordinator told us we had broken the record for this year's fundraiser. Everyone cheered.
Q: What was the writer doing when the news was announced?
options: A. Cheering loudly
B. Putting items into boxes
C. Breaking a record
D. Calling the coordinator
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解與過去進行式。問題問「當消息宣布時作者正在做什麼？」。第一句說 "I was packing donation boxes when..."（當...時我正在打包捐贈箱），packing boxes 意即 putting items into boxes，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Exhibition Guide: Visitors are required to turn off their phone flashes. Taking photos using a flash might permanently ruin the ancient paintings.
Q: What must visitors avoid doing?
options: A. Touching the paintings
B. Bringing their phones
C. Using a flash for photos
D. Speaking loudly
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。指南中要求訪客關閉手機閃光燈，並指出使用閃光燈拍照可能會毀壞畫作，因此訪客必須避免使用閃光燈拍照 (Using a flash for photos)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Property Update: The landlord promised to repair the broken elevator next week. Residents who live on higher floors have complained about climbing the stairs daily.
Q: What did the landlord promise?
options: A. To clean the stairs
B. To reduce the rent
C. To install a balcony
D. To fix the elevator
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中第一句提到 "The landlord promised to repair the broken elevator"（房東答應修復壞掉的電梯），repair 等同於 fix，因此選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文】Wellness Blog: While I was dealing with severe anxiety, a friend suggested trying meditation. It surprisingly helped me calm my racing thoughts.
Q: What helped the writer calm down?
options: A. Meditation
B. Medication
C. Sleeping pills
D. Seeing a doctor
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中提到朋友建議嘗試 meditation（冥想），且「It surprisingly helped me calm...」（它出乎意料地幫助我平靜下來），此處的 It 指的就是冥想，故選 A。選項 B (Medication 藥物) 是常見的混淆字。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech News: Many users regret trusting the fake website. The fraudsters created a page that looked exactly like the official bank portal to deceive victims.
Q: How did the fraudsters trick people?
options: A. By sending fake emails
B. By designing a realistic fake site
C. By stealing credit cards directly
D. By calling them on the phone
normal.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中說騙子創造了一個「looked exactly like the official bank portal (看起來完全像官方銀行入口)」的網頁來欺騙受害者。這符合選項 B「設計逼真的假網站」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The candidate who walked in earlier has an impressive portfolio.
options: A. 剛走進來的求職者作品集令人印象深刻。
B. 那位面試官的要求非常嚴格。
C. 剛才離開的應徵者忘記帶資料了。
D. 這個職位需要有經驗的候選人。
normal.explain: The candidate who walked in earlier has an impressive portfolio.（剛走進來的求職者作品集令人印象深刻。）candidate 為求職者/候選人，who 引導關係子句修飾 candidate。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We require all new hires to undergo background checks.
options: A. 我們要求所有新員工進行背景調查。
B. 所有員工都需要定期檢查身體。
C. 新員工可以拒絕提供背景資料。
D. 我們正在調查新進員工的滿意度。
normal.explain: We require all new hires to undergo background checks.（我們要求所有新員工進行背景調查。）require sb to do sth 為要求某人做某事，undergo 表示經歷、接受。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Are you familiar with the software that we use for payroll?
options: A. Yes, I have used it extensively in my previous job.
B. No, the software was updated yesterday.
C. I was repairing the computer at that time.
D. The payroll will be processed next week.
normal.explain: Are you familiar with the software that we use for payroll?（你熟悉我們用來處理薪資的軟體嗎？）A 選項「是的，我在上一份工作經常使用它」最符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She was filling in for the manager when the audit took place.
options: A. 她正在填寫經理的評估表格。
B. 審計發生時她正在代理經理的職務。
C. 經理在審計期間剛好請假去度假了。
D. 審計員正在尋找經理的相關文件。
normal.explain: She was filling in for the manager when the audit took place.（審計進行時她正在代理經理的職務。）fill in for sb 意思是代替、代理某人，過去進行式表達當時正在發生的動作。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Would you mind briefly introducing the colleagues who will be on my team?
options: A. I usually take the bus to work.
B. Not at all. Let me introduce you to them.
C. The meeting room is on the right side.
D. You should avoid wearing casual clothes.
normal.explain: Would you mind briefly introducing the colleagues who will be on my team?（你介意簡單介紹一下我團隊的同事嗎？）B 選項「完全不會。讓我把你介紹給他們」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please make sure to read the employee handbook thoroughly.
options: A. 請確保在圖書館借閱這本手冊。
B. 請務必將員工手冊交給經理。
C. 請確保仔細閱讀員工手冊。
D. 員工必須撰寫一本詳細的手冊。
normal.explain: Please make sure to read the employee handbook thoroughly.（請確保仔細閱讀員工手冊。）make sure to V 為務必做某事，thoroughly 為徹底地、仔細地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I suggest setting up an orientation session for the newcomers.
options: A. 我建議為新進人員安排一次迎新介紹。
B. 新人建議先參觀一下辦公環境。
C. 我打算拒絕參加這次的新人培訓。
D. 這次迎新活動需要花費很多時間。
normal.explain: I suggest setting up an orientation session for the newcomers.（我建議為新進人員安排一次迎新介紹。）suggest 後接動名詞 (V-ing)，orientation session 指迎新或入職培訓。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Were you taking notes during the presentation that the HR director gave?
options: A. Yes, I wrote down all the key policies mentioned.
B. The presentation will start in ten minutes.
C. HR is located on the fifth floor.
D. She was talking about her vacation in Spain.
normal.explain: Were you taking notes during the presentation that the HR director gave?（人資主管簡報時你有在做筆記嗎？）A 選項「是的，我寫下了提到的所有關鍵政策」最為恰當。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The tour guide who leads this group is extremely knowledgeable.
options: A. 帶領這個團隊的導遊知識非常淵博。
B. 這個旅遊團正在尋找一位導遊。
C. 這位導遊對旅遊景點感到不滿。
D. 導遊要求我們跟緊他的腳步。
normal.explain: The tour guide who leads this group is extremely knowledgeable.（帶領這個團隊的導遊知識非常淵博。）who leads this group 修飾導遊，knowledgeable 表示知識豐富的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Could you repeat the departure time for the bus which goes to the palace?
options: A. The palace was built in the sixteenth century.
B. It leaves at nine thirty sharp from the front gate.
C. You should pack a warm jacket for the trip.
D. The bus was completely empty yesterday.
normal.explain: Could you repeat the departure time for the bus which goes to the palace?（你能重複一下前往宮殿的巴士出發時間嗎？）B 選項「它會在九點半準時從前門出發」直接回答了時間。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We are planning to visit a village that is famous for its pottery.
options: A. 我們打算買一些有名的陶器作為紀念品。
B. 我們計畫參觀一個以陶器聞名的村莊。
C. 那個村莊的村民正在製作精美的陶器。
D. 這個地區的陶器銷量非常好。
normal.explain: We are planning to visit a village that is famous for its pottery.（我們計畫參觀一個以陶器聞名的村莊。）plan to V 表計畫，that is famous for 關係子句修飾 village。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was checking the map when I realized we had taken the wrong path.
options: A. 我們迷路時，地圖剛好掉在路邊了。
B. 我正在看地圖時，才意識到我們走錯路了。
C. 他在找正確的路線，因為地圖標示不清。
D. 我們發現走對路後，就把地圖收起來了。
normal.explain: I was checking the map when I realized we had taken the wrong path.（我正在看地圖時，才意識到我們走錯路了。）過去進行式 was checking 搭配簡單過去式 realized。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Remember to keep your belongings close to you in crowded areas.
options: A. The crowd was cheering for the performers.
B. I will. Thanks for the heads up.
C. I prefer taking a taxi to the hotel.
D. The belongings are locked in the safe.
normal.explain: Remember to keep your belongings close to you in crowded areas.（記住在擁擠的地方要把隨身物品放在身邊。）B 選項「我會的。謝謝你的提醒」是合理的回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The principal who delivered the opening speech is retiring soon.
options: A. 負責招生的校長很快就要升職了。
B. 發表開幕致詞的校長即將退休。
C. 準備演講稿的老師已經離職了。
D. 校長正在考慮邀請貴賓來演講。
normal.explain: The principal who delivered the opening speech is retiring soon.（發表開幕致詞的校長即將退休。）deliver a speech 意為發表演講，who 引導關係子句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Many parents expressed concerns regarding the school cafeteria menu.
options: A. 許多家長對學校餐廳的菜單表示擔憂。
B. 學校決定取消餐廳的午餐供應。
C. 家長們希望學校能增加體育課的時間。
D. 老師對學生在餐廳的表現感到不滿。
normal.explain: Many parents expressed concerns regarding the school cafeteria menu.（許多家長對學校餐廳的菜單表示擔憂。）express concerns regarding... 意為對...表達擔憂或關注。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Were the teachers discussing the new curriculum when you arrived?
options: A. Yes, they were going over the math syllabus.
B. The curriculum is quite challenging this year.
C. I was looking for the parents' association.
D. They will finish the meeting at noon.
normal.explain: Were the teachers discussing the new curriculum when you arrived?（你到達時，老師們正在討論新課綱嗎？）A 選項「是的，他們正在看數學教學大綱」符合過去進行式的問句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I urge you to encourage your children to read more books.
options: A. 我強烈建議您親自教孩子讀書。
B. 孩子們應該每天去圖書館借書。
C. 我敦促您鼓勵您的孩子多看書。
D. 學校規定學生每週必須讀一本書。
normal.explain: I urge you to encourage your children to read more books.（我敦促您鼓勵您的孩子多看書。）urge sb to V 為強烈勸告/敦促某人做某事，encourage sb to V 為鼓勵某人做某事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you know if the fund raising event that was scheduled for Friday is canceled?
options: A. The event was extremely successful.
B. Yes, they decided to postpone it due to the rain.
C. I have already donated some money.
D. Friday is usually my busiest day.
normal.explain: Do you know if the fund raising event that was scheduled for Friday is canceled?（你知道原定於週五的募款活動是否取消了嗎？）B 選項「是的，因為下雨他們決定延期」符合語境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor picnic.
options: A. 由於大雨，我們被迫取消了戶外野餐。
B. 下大雨時，我們正在戶外舉行野餐。
C. 雖然下雨，野餐還是如期舉行了。
D. 我們決定把戶外野餐移到室內。
normal.explain: The heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor picnic.（由於大雨，我們被迫取消了戶外野餐。）force sb to do sth 迫使某人做某事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was packing my sunglasses when I heard the weather forecast.
options: A. 聽完天氣預報後，我決定把太陽眼鏡拿出來。
B. 天氣預報說今天陽光很強，所以我帶了太陽眼鏡。
C. 我正在收太陽眼鏡時，聽到了天氣預報。
D. 我把太陽眼鏡弄丟了，剛好電視在播天氣預報。
normal.explain: I was packing my sunglasses when I heard the weather forecast.（我正在收太陽眼鏡時，聽到了天氣預報。）過去進行式搭配 when，表示正在進行某事時突然發生另一件事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Since it is snowing heavily, should we consider delaying the hike?
options: A. The hike was surprisingly easy.
B. Yes, it's too dangerous to go up the mountain now.
C. We were walking in the snow for hours.
D. The snow makes the scenery look beautiful.
normal.explain: Since it is snowing heavily, should we consider delaying the hike?（既然雪下得很大，我們是否該考慮延後遠足？）B 選項「是的，現在上山太危險了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We ended up playing board games instead of going to the beach.
options: A. 我們去海邊玩了桌遊。
B. 我們最後玩了桌遊，而不是去海邊。
C. 在去海邊之前，我們先玩了桌遊。
D. 因為去不了海邊，我們決定取消玩桌遊。
normal.explain: We ended up playing board games instead of going to the beach.（我們最後玩了桌遊，而不是去海邊。）end up + V-ing 表示最終落得...的結果，instead of 表示而不是。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The storm which hit the coast last night caused severe delays.
options: A. 昨晚的暴風雨讓我們不得不提早出發。
B. 昨晚襲擊海岸的暴風雨造成了嚴重的延誤。
C. 暴風雨來臨前，海岸線已經封閉了。
D. 海岸邊的居民對暴風雨感到非常擔憂。
normal.explain: The storm which hit the coast last night caused severe delays.（昨晚襲擊海岸的暴風雨造成了嚴重的延誤。）which 引導的關係子句修飾 storm，severe delays 為嚴重的延誤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I am entirely fed up with dealing with my noisy roommates.
options: A. 我對處理我吵鬧的室友感到徹底厭煩了。
B. 我的室友每天晚上都吵著要吃飯。
C. 我正在試著與吵鬧的室友溝通。
D. 我很享受和室友一起分享生活的時光。
normal.explain: I am entirely fed up with dealing with my noisy roommates.（我對處理我吵鬧的室友感到徹底厭煩了。）be fed up with 表示對...感到受夠了，後接動名詞 dealing。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I was trying to concentrate on my work when he started complaining again.
options: A. That must be very frustrating for you.
B. He usually complains about the weather.
C. You should try to complain as well.
D. I was watching a movie yesterday.
normal.explain: I was trying to concentrate on my work when he started complaining again.（我正努力專心工作時，他又開始抱怨了。）A 選項「那對你來說一定很挫折」表達了適當的安慰與同理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: It is useless to argue with someone who refuses to listen.
options: A. 和拒絕傾聽的人爭論是沒有用的。
B. 那些不願意聽從建議的人總是在爭論。
C. 拒絕傾聽的人通常都有很多有用的意見。
D. 你必須學會和不聽話的人溝通。
normal.explain: It is useless to argue with someone who refuses to listen.（和拒絕傾聽的人爭論是沒有用的。）It is useless to V 為做某事是無用的，who 引導關係子句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: She keeps interrupting me whenever I try to explain my point of view.
options: A. Maybe you should talk to her directly about how you feel.
B. She was explaining the rules to everyone.
C. I prefer to keep my view to myself.
D. The meeting was interrupted by a loud noise.
normal.explain: She keeps interrupting me whenever I try to explain my point of view.（每當我試圖解釋我的觀點時，她總是打斷我。）A 選項「或許你應該直接跟她談談你的感受」提供了合理的朋友間建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You seem really stressed. Do you want to talk about it?
options: A. 你的工作壓力似乎很大，需要休息一下嗎？
B. 你看起來壓力很大。想談談嗎？
C. 我覺得你應該停止談論這些有壓力的事情。
D. 我們可以一起討論如何減輕壓力。
normal.explain: You seem really stressed. Do you want to talk about it?（你看起來壓力很大。想談談嗎？）seem 加上形容詞表示看起來...，這句常被朋友用來關心對方。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I appreciate your patience while I was sorting out the mess.
options: A. 我很欣賞你在解決混亂時表現出的耐心。
B. 我很感謝我在整理爛攤子時，你能保持耐心。
C. 感謝你耐心教導我如何清理房間。
D. 我們應該耐心等待，直到混亂被解決。
normal.explain: I appreciate your patience while I was sorting out the mess.（我很感謝我在整理爛攤子時，你能保持耐心。）appreciate + N 表示感謝，while 引導過去進行式的時間副詞子句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The client who I was assisting yesterday completely ignored my advice.
options: A. Advice is always helpful.
B. I am sorry to hear that. Don't let it bother you too much.
C. The client arrived very late yesterday.
D. You were assisting the manager last week.
normal.explain: The client who I was assisting yesterday completely ignored my advice.（昨天我協助的那個客戶完全無視了我的建議。）B 選項「很遺憾聽到這個。別讓它太影響你」展現了朋友間的安慰。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We are evaluating the performance of the software which was just launched.
options: A. 我們正在升級剛發布的軟體版本。
B. 我們正在評估剛推出的這款軟體的效能。
C. 這款剛發布的軟體出現了嚴重的問題。
D. 我們打算終止這款軟體的後續開發。
normal.explain: We are evaluating the performance of the software which was just launched.（我們正在評估剛推出的這款軟體的效能。）evaluate 為評估，which引導關係子句修飾 software。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I am thinking about quitting my job to travel the world.
options: A. That sounds like a huge decision. Have you saved enough money?
B. The world is getting smaller every day.
C. I was working in the office all day.
D. Traveling for business can be exhausting.
normal.explain: I am thinking about quitting my job to travel the world.（我正在考慮辭職去環遊世界。）A 選項「聽起來是個重大的決定。你存夠錢了嗎？」是朋友間常見的反應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The seminar that covers leadership skills is mandatory for all managers.
options: A. 涵蓋領導技巧的研討會對所有經理來說是必修的。
B. 經理們被要求組織一場關於領導力的研討會。
C. 只有少數經理參加了這場領導力研討會。
D. 這場研討會的講者是位優秀的領導者。
normal.explain: The seminar that covers leadership skills is mandatory for all managers.（涵蓋領導技巧的研討會對所有經理來說是必修的。）that covers leadership skills 修飾 seminar，mandatory 意為強制的、義務的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I was drafting the proposal when the system crashed abruptly.
options: A. 系統崩潰後，我才開始起草這份提案。
B. 我正在起草提案時，系統突然崩潰了。
C. 因為系統問題，我無法完成這份草案。
D. 提案的草稿導致了系統嚴重當機。
normal.explain: I was drafting the proposal when the system crashed abruptly.（我正在起草提案時，系統突然崩潰了。）draft 意為起草，abruptly 為突然地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Do you mind reviewing the document which I sent earlier today?
options: A. I already sent the document to the printer.
B. Sure, I'll take a look at it right after this meeting.
C. The reviewer gave us positive feedback.
D. I was writing an email when you walked in.
normal.explain: Do you mind reviewing the document which I sent earlier today?（你介意審查我今天稍早寄出的文件嗎？）B 選項「沒問題，我開完會馬上看」最合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted accidentally deleting the important folder.
options: A. 他承認不小心刪除了重要的資料夾。
B. 他否認曾經看過那個重要的文件。
C. 他正在尋找被意外刪除的檔案。
D. 他承認自己忘記儲存檔案了。
normal.explain: He admitted accidentally deleting the important folder.（他承認不小心刪除了重要的資料夾。）admit + V-ing 表示承認做過某事，accidentally 為意外地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We plan on launching the new campaign next quarter.
options: A. 我們打算在下個季度推出新的行銷活動。
B. 上個季度的行銷活動取得了巨大成功。
C. 我們正在評估是否要推遲新產品的發布。
D. 這次的活動計畫需要更多資金支持。
normal.explain: We plan on launching the new campaign next quarter.（我們打算在下個季度推出新的行銷活動。）plan on + V-ing 表示打算做某事，campaign 指活動（多用於商業或政治）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The colleague who sits next to me is always talking on the phone.
options: A. That sounds annoying. Have you tried wearing headphones?
B. He is a very good listener.
C. I was talking on the phone with a client.
D. The phone in the office is broken.
normal.explain: The colleague who sits next to me is always talking on the phone.（坐在我旁邊的同事總是在講電話。）A 選項「聽起來很煩人。你試過戴耳機嗎？」符合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The customer was complaining about the service when the manager intervened.
options: A. 當經理介入時，顧客正在抱怨服務。
B. 顧客抱怨完服務後，經理才介入。
C. 經理正在抱怨服務，顧客於是介入。
D. 顧客要求經理出面抱怨服務。
boss.explain: The customer was complaining... when the manager intervened. 意思是「經理介入時，顧客正在抱怨服務。」（過去進行式搭配過去式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The document that you requested has been attached to this email.
options: A. 你附上的文件需要用電子郵件寄出。
B. 你要求的文件已經附在這封電子郵件裡了。
C. 這封電子郵件是你要求的文件。
D. 我要求你將文件附在電子郵件裡。
boss.explain: The document that you requested... 意思是「你要求的那份文件已經作為附件隨信附上。」（關係代名詞 that）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We regret to inform you that your application was denied.
options: A. 我們很遺憾你的申請表寫錯了。
B. 我們很遺憾地通知您，您的申請被拒絕了。
C. 我們忘記通知您，您的申請已被拒絕。
D. 您很遺憾地拒絕了我們的申請。
boss.explain: We regret to inform you... 意思是「我們很遺憾地通知您，申請已被拒絕。」（regret to V 遺憾要去做某事）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He finished writing the proposal just before the deadline.
options: A. 他在截止日期後才寫完提案。
B. 他在截止日期前剛好寫完提案。
C. 他提議在截止日期前寫完文件。
D. 截止日期前他根本還沒開始寫提案。
boss.explain: He finished writing the proposal... 意思是「他在截止期限前剛好寫完提案。」（finish + V-ing）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The flight attendant recommended keeping our seatbelts fastened.
options: A. 空服員建議我們保持安全帶扣好。
B. 空服員推薦我們買一條新的安全帶。
C. 空服員提醒我們解開安全帶。
D. 空服員堅持自己要扣好安全帶。
boss.explain: The flight attendant recommended keeping... 意思是「空服員建議保持安全帶繫好。」（recommend + V-ing）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Were they discussing the new budget when you entered the room?
options: A. The room is very bright and spacious.
B. Yes, they were going over the numbers for next year.
C. I entered the room quietly.
D. They discuss the budget every week.
boss.explain: 問句：你進房間時，他們正在討論新預算嗎？（過去進行式）。B「是的，他們正在看明年的數字」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The reporter who broke the news is being interviewed on channel five.
options: A. Let's turn it on and watch what he has to say.
B. The news is very depressing today.
C. Breaking the rules is not allowed.
D. Channel five is a good channel.
boss.explain: 句子：爆出這則新聞的記者正在第五頻道接受採訪（關係代名詞 who）。A「我們打開電視看看他怎麼說吧」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you remember sending the itinerary to the clients?
options: A. The itinerary is very detailed.
B. Yes, I emailed it to them yesterday morning.
C. I remember nothing about the client.
D. Sending emails is part of my job.
boss.explain: 問句：你記得有把行程表寄給客戶嗎？（remember + V-ing 記得做過某事）。B「記得，我昨天早上用Email寄給他們了」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The doctor promised to call me as soon as the test results are ready.
options: A. The test was very difficult.
B. That's good. I hope everything turns out fine.
C. Doctors are usually very busy.
D. I promise to be there on time.
boss.explain: 句子：醫生答應檢驗結果一出來就會打電話給我（promise to V）。B「太好了，希望一切順利」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We are committed to providing the best possible service.
options: A. I am not committed to this relationship.
B. That's why your company has such a great reputation.
C. Providing service is very hard.
D. The best is yet to come.
boss.explain: 句子：我們致力於提供最好的服務（be committed to + V-ing）。B「這就是為什麼你們公司有這麼好的聲譽」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The medication which I took last night made me feel drowsy all morning.
options: A. You should probably ask the pharmacist if that's a normal side effect.
B. I like taking medication.
C. The morning is the best time of the day.
D. Drowsiness is not a disease.
boss.explain: 句子：我昨晚吃的藥讓我整個早上都昏昏欲睡（關係代名詞 which）。A「你或許該問問藥師那是否為正常的副作用」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She managed to resolve the customer's issue without escalating it to management.
options: A. The issue is very complicated.
B. That's impressive. She has excellent problem-solving skills.
C. Management is always right.
D. Escalating an issue is not recommended.
boss.explain: 句子：她成功解決了客戶的問題，而沒有往上呈報給管理層（manage to V）。B「真令人佩服，她有很棒的解決問題能力」最合適。

boss.desc: 【文法】The management team is considering ___ a four-day workweek to boost employee morale.
options: A. to implement
B. implementing
C. implement
D. implemented
boss.explain: consider（考慮）作為動詞時，後方須接動名詞（V-ing）當作受詞。

boss.desc: 【短文】Tech Magazine: The startup, which was founded by two university students, recently secured a million-dollar investment. Their app helps people track their daily carbon footprint. Q: What is true about the startup?
options: A. It was founded by investors.
B. It tracks people's physical steps.
C. It was created by university students.
D. It lost a million dollars.
boss.explain: 短文中提到「which was founded by two university students」，表示這家新創公司是兩位大學生創辦的。

boss.desc: 【文法】We met a consultant yesterday ___ advice saved our company from bankruptcy.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. whose
D. which
boss.explain: 先行詞 consultant（顧問）與 advice（建議）之間具有所有格關係（那位顧問的建議），故填 whose。

boss.desc: 【時態】I couldn't hear what the speaker was saying because the people behind me ___ loudly.
options: A. talk
B. are talking
C. were talking
D. will talk
boss.explain: 主要子句（couldn't hear）是過去式，表示當時聽不到是因為後面的人「當時正在」大聲說話，需用過去進行式。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Alert: Passengers who are traveling to Tokyo should proceed to Gate 5 immediately. The flight, which was delayed due to bad weather, is now ready for boarding. Q: Why was the flight delayed?
options: A. Because of a technical issue.
B. Because the gate was changed.
C. Because of bad weather.
D. Because passengers were late.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出「delayed due to bad weather」，即因為天氣惡劣而延誤。

boss.desc: 【文法】It is generally a good idea to avoid ___ sensitive personal questions during a job interview.
options: A. to ask
B. ask
C. asking
D. asked
boss.explain: avoid 後面必須接動名詞（V-ing），表示避免做某件事。

boss.desc: 【短文】Biography: Maria, who spent her childhood in a small village, always dreamed of becoming an architect. She was sketching buildings while other kids were playing outside. Q: What did Maria do when other kids played outside?
options: A. She played with them.
B. She sketched buildings.
C. She visited architects.
D. She explored the village.
boss.explain: 文章指出「She was sketching buildings while other kids were playing outside.」，選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Company Policy: Employees are expected to stop taking personal calls during working hours. If there is an emergency, please use the designated break area. Q: What does the policy ask employees to do?
options: A. Stop to make personal calls anytime.
B. Use the break area for all work calls.
C. Cease making personal calls while working.
D. Stop working to take personal calls.
boss.explain: stop taking personal calls 意思是「停止接聽私人電話（不再做這件事）」，cease 即為 stop 的同義字，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【時態】While the government ___ to find a solution to the pollution problem, local activists organized a massive cleanup event on the beach.
options: A. struggles
B. was struggling
C. has struggled
D. is struggling
boss.explain: 後半句為過去簡單式（organized），While 帶出的背景動作通常為過去進行式，表示當時政府正為了找尋解方而努力。

boss.desc: 【文法】The manager threatened ___ the employee if he continued to be late for work.
options: A. firing
B. fire
C. to fire
D. fired
boss.explain: threaten（威脅）後面須接不定詞（to V），表示威脅要去做某事。

boss.desc: 【短文】Wildlife Conservation: The organization focuses on protecting sea turtles, which are currently facing extinction due to habitat loss. Volunteers patrol the beaches every night. Q: What is causing the sea turtles to face extinction?
options: A. Volunteer patrols.
B. Habitat loss.
C. Climate cooling.
D. Lack of food.
boss.explain: 文中提到「facing extinction due to habitat loss」，due to 表示原因，即棲息地喪失。

boss.desc: 【文法】The old bridge ___ collapsed yesterday was built over a hundred years ago.
options: A. who
B. that
C. where
D. what
boss.explain: 修飾事物（bridge）且在子句中作主詞，這裡沒有逗號（限定用法），用 that 或 which 皆可，選項中只有 that 符合。

boss.desc: 【對話】A: Did you see Jim? B: He ___ the presentation materials when I left the office, so he might still be there.
options: A. prepares
B. was preparing
C. has prepared
D. will prepare
boss.explain: 根據 when I left the office（當我離開辦公室時），表達在那個過去的時間點 Jim 正在準備資料，故選 B。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我避免在尖峰時間開車

boss.speak: i avoid driving during rush hour

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們選的飯店很棒

boss.desc: 請唸出：你介意更改時程表嗎

boss.desc: 請唸出：她來的時候我正在看書

boss.desc: 請唸出：昨天來拜訪我們的客戶

boss.speak: the client who visited us yesterday

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們期待與您見面

boss.speak: supervisor

boss.speak: accommodation

boss.speak: apologize

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ S T I N _ T I _ N (目的地)
boss.speak: destination

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The package which arrived today is for you.
options: A. 你今天要寄出一個包裹。
B. 昨天抵達的包裹是給你的。
C. 今天送達的那個包裹是給你的。
D. 你必須今天去領取這個包裹。
boss.explain: 原句：The package which arrived today is for you. (今天送達的那個包裹是給你的。) 測試關係代名詞 which 較長句型。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I finished reading the report last night.
options: A. 我昨晚把報告寫完了。
B. 我昨晚讀完了那份報告。
C. 昨晚的報告終於結束了。
D. 我打算今晚讀完這份報告。
boss.explain: 原句：I finished reading the report last night. (我昨晚讀完了那份報告。) 測試 finish + V-ing。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We decided to hire a new assistant.
options: A. 我們正在面試新的助理。
B. 助理決定要辭職了。
C. 我們決定要聘請一位新助理。
D. 新助理決定要接受這份工作。
boss.explain: 原句：We decided to hire a new assistant. (我們決定要聘請一位新助理。) 測試 decide to + V。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today?
options: A. I called you yesterday morning.
B. I am trying to track a missing order.
C. The service here is excellent.
D. How do you help customers?
boss.explain: 原句：Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today? (感謝致電客服，今天能怎麼幫忙您？) 客戶常回答目的，故選 B (我正在試著追蹤一筆遺失的訂單)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Attention all passengers. Flight 808 is now boarding at gate twelve.
options: A. 808 航班已經在十二號登機門起飛了。
B. 請注意，808 航班更改到十二號登機門。
C. 各位旅客請注意，808 航班現在於十二號登機門開始登機。
D. 808 航班的旅客請前往十二號登機門領取行李。
boss.explain: 原句：Attention all passengers. Flight 808 is now boarding at gate twelve. 機場廣播情境，boarding 意為「登機」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The pharmacy that is open 24 hours is located on Main Street.
options: A. 位於主街的藥局今晚會開到 24 點。
B. 那間 24 小時營業的藥局位在主街上。
C. 主街上新開了一家 24 小時營業的藥局。
D. 藥局老闆在主街上開了 24 個小時的車。
boss.explain: 原句：The pharmacy that is open 24 hours is located on Main Street. (那間 24 小時營業的藥局位在主街上。) 測試關係代名詞 that。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I highly recommend taking a taxi if you are in a hurry.
options: A. 如果你很趕時間，我強烈建議你搭計程車。
B. 我建議計程車司機開快一點，因為我很趕時間。
C. 雖然你很急，但我還是不建議你搭計程車。
D. 這位計程車司機非常推薦你慢慢來。
boss.explain: 原句：I highly recommend taking a taxi if you are in a hurry. (如果你很趕時間，我強烈建議你搭計程車。) 測試 recommend + V-ing。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I apologize for the delay. We are currently experiencing high call volumes.
options: A. 很抱歉讓您久等，我們正在調整通話音量。
B. 對於延遲感到抱歉，目前我們的進線量非常大。
C. 我為延遲道歉，請您大聲一點說話。
D. 因為電話數量不足，導致我們的服務延遲，請見諒。
boss.explain: 原句：I apologize for the delay. We are currently experiencing high call volumes. (對於延遲感到抱歉，目前我們的進線量非常大。) 常見客服用語。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They are planning to renovate the lobby next month.
options: A. 他們上個月剛剛翻修完大廳。
B. 他們計畫在下個月翻修大廳。
C. 下個月的大廳會非常熱鬧。
D. 大廳的翻修計畫被延到下個月了。
boss.explain: 原句：They are planning to renovate the lobby next month. (他們計畫在下個月翻修大廳。) 測試 plan to + V。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you taking any medication for those symptoms?
options: A. Yes, I take the train every day.
B. I am feeling much better now.
C. Yes, the doctor prescribed some pills.
D. No, I haven't meditated lately.
boss.explain: 原句：Are you taking any medication for those symptoms? (你有針對那些症狀服用任何藥物嗎？) 詢問醫療狀況，回答 C (有，醫生開了一些藥丸) 最正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The guest who is staying in room 302 needs some extra towels.
options: A. 住在 302 號房的客人需要一些額外的毛巾。
B. 302 號房的客人剛剛送來了一些毛巾。
C. 請問 302 號房的客人還需要毛巾嗎？
D. 客房服務正在為 302 號房準備毛巾。
boss.explain: 原句：The guest who is staying in room 302 needs some extra towels. (住在 302 號房的客人需要一些額外的毛巾。) 測試關係代名詞 who。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I would like to speak to the person who is in charge of marketing.
options: A. I will charge your credit card now.
B. Speaking. How can I assist you?
C. He is charging his phone.
D. Marketing is a very difficult job.
boss.explain: 原句：I would like to speak to the person who is in charge of marketing. (我想跟負責行銷的人說話。) 回答 B (我就是。能怎麼幫忙您？) 是商業通話中標準的接話方式。

boss.desc: 【短文】Health Report: A recent survey shows that office workers who sit for more than eight hours a day face a higher risk of back pain. The researchers urge people to take short walks. Q: What does the report say about office workers?
options: A. They may suffer from back pain if they sit too long.
B. They should sleep for eight hours a day.
C. They are urged to buy new office chairs.
D. They face a higher risk of heart disease.
boss.explain: 文中提到久坐超過八小時的辦公室員工面臨較高的背痛風險 (face a higher risk of back pain)，因此選 A。其他選項文中皆未提及。

boss.desc: 【短文】Sleep Study: While doctors were observing the volunteers, they found that those who listened to soft music fell asleep faster. The study aims to help people with sleep problems. Q: What happened during the observation?
options: A. Volunteers played musical instruments.
B. Soft music helped volunteers fall asleep sooner.
C. Doctors fell asleep while listening to music.
D. Volunteers refused to listen to any music.
boss.explain: 文中提到「those who listened to soft music fell asleep faster（聽輕音樂的人更快入睡）」，符合 B 的描述。C 是醫生睡著，錯誤。

boss.desc: 【短文】Clinic Notice: Patients who suffer from severe seasonal allergies should avoid outdoor activities during the spring. The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. Q: What does the clinic offer this month?
options: A. Free medicine.
B. Outdoor activities.
C. Free allergy tests.
D. Spring vacation packages.
boss.explain: 告示中最後一句明確寫道「The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. (診所本月提供免費過敏測試)」，因此選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Traffic Update: The main bridge, which crosses the river, is temporarily closed for maintenance. Drivers are advised to use the alternate route through the tunnel. Q: Why should drivers use the tunnel?
options: A. The tunnel is faster.
B. The river is flooding.
C. The main bridge is under maintenance.
D. There is an accident on the bridge.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The main bridge... is temporarily closed for maintenance (主橋因維修暫時封閉)」，所以建議駕駛改走隧道，選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】City Notice: The government plans to build a new park in the center of the city. The project, which will begin next year, aims to provide a green space for families. Q: What is the purpose of the new project?
options: A. To build a new parking lot.
B. To create a green area for families.
C. To start a city government office.
D. To plant trees along the highway.
boss.explain: 文中說明這個計畫的目的是「aims to provide a green space for families (旨在為家庭提供綠地)」，因此正確答案是 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Change: Starting in January, cars that enter the city center during rush hour will be charged a fee. The fee is designed to decrease air pollution. Q: Which cars will be charged?
options: A. Cars entering the city center during peak hours.
B. All cars driving outside the city.
C. Cars parked in the city center overnight.
D. Cars that are electric and eco-friendly.
boss.explain: 文中提到「cars that enter the city center during rush hour will be charged a fee」，rush hour 同義於 peak hours（尖峰時段），故選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】HR Memo: The specialist who usually handles conflict resolution is currently on leave. If you face any urgent issues, please contact the department head directly. Q: Who should employees contact for urgent issues?
options: A. The specialist on leave.
B. The department head.
C. The security guard.
D. The police.
boss.explain: 備忘錄指出專家目前休假中，遇到緊急問題請直接聯絡「the department head (部門主管)」，因此選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Email Etiquette: Professionals who write clear and concise emails often save their coworkers a lot of time. It is best to keep the subject line direct. Q: What is the benefit of writing clear emails?
options: A. It guarantees a promotion.
B. It makes the email look longer.
C. It saves coworkers' time.
D. It hides the main topic.
boss.explain: 文中提到清楚簡潔的郵件「often save their coworkers a lot of time (經常能節省同事的時間)」，所以選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Workshop Memo: The communication workshop will focus on active listening. Employees attending the session must turn off their phones to avoid distracting others. Q: What is required of the employees in the workshop?
options: A. To bring their laptops.
B. To turn off their mobile phones.
C. To talk continuously.
D. To distract other people.
boss.explain: 備忘錄中明確規定參加者「must turn off their phones (必須關閉手機)」，以避免干擾他人，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Cultural Event: The night market, which attracts thousands of visitors every weekend, features various local snacks and games. It is a perfect place to experience the local lifestyle. Q: What can visitors do at the night market?
options: A. Try local snacks and games.
B. Buy international airline tickets.
C. Watch traditional indoor theater.
D. Avoid crowded places.
boss.explain: 文中說夜市「features various local snacks and games (以各種當地小吃和遊戲為特色)」，所以遊客可以嘗試小吃和遊戲，選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】Return Policy: Buyers should consider returning the item if it does not match the description online. A full refund will be processed within seven business days. Q: Under what condition should a buyer return an item?
options: A. If it is different from the online description.
B. If they used it for a year.
C. If they want a different color.
D. If it arrives earlier than expected.
boss.explain: 文中提到「if it does not match the description online (如果不符合網路上的描述)」，同義於 A 選項的 different from the online description。

boss.desc: 【短文】Consumer Rights: If an item is faulty, buyers have the right to demand a replacement or a refund. Stores that deny this right can be reported to the consumer protection agency. Q: What can buyers do if they purchase a faulty item?
options: A. They must fix the item themselves.
B. They can ask for a replacement or get their money back.
C. They have to report it to the police.
D. They should ignore the problem.
boss.explain: 文章說買家有權利「demand a replacement or a refund (要求換貨或退款)」，這與 B 選項的意思完全一致。

boss.desc: 【短文】Product Recall: The manufacturer is recalling the electric kettles because they overheat easily. Anyone who owns this model should stop using it immediately. Q: Why are the electric kettles being recalled?
options: A. They are too small.
B. They use too much electricity.
C. They are not popular.
D. They get too hot and may be dangerous.
boss.explain: 文中表示召回熱水壺是因為它們「overheat easily (容易過熱)」，對應到 D 選項的 get too hot and may be dangerous。

B. He was speaking to the manager.
C. I think the economy is improving.

boss.explain: 原句：Is he the guest speaker who is giving the talk on economics? 意思：他是那位要進行經濟學演講的客座講者嗎？正確回應是 A. 是的，他剛從倫敦抵達。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We need to figure out how to operate this new projector.
options: A. The project will be finished soon.
B. Let me ask the technician for help.
C. I was projecting the sales figures.
D. It operates on batteries only.
boss.explain: 原句：We need to figure out how to operate this new projector. 意思：我們需要弄清楚怎麼操作這台新投影機。正確回應是 B. 讓我找技師幫忙。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Is this the trophy that they won at the championship?
options: A. The champion is very strong.
B. Yes, they are going to win.
C. Yes, it was presented to them yesterday.
D. No, the championship is next week.
boss.explain: 原句：Is this the trophy that they won at the championship? 意思：這是他們在錦標賽贏得的獎盃嗎？正確回應是 C. 是的，這是昨天頒發給他們的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What were the coaches explaining before the second half started?
options: A. They will discuss the strategy soon.
B. The second half is about to begin.
C. I discussed it with my team.
D. They were talking about changing the defensive strategy.
boss.explain: 原句：What were the coaches explaining before the second half started? 意思：下半場開始前教練們在解說什麼？正確回應是 D. 他們正在談論改變防守策略。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Can I speak to the staff member who handled my bags?
options: A. He is currently on a break, but I can assist you.
B. The bags are very heavy.
C. I can handle the situation for you.
D. You spoke to the manager yesterday.
boss.explain: 原句：Can I speak to the staff member who handled my bags? 意思：我可以和處理我行李的那位員工說話嗎？正確回應是 A. 他目前在休息，但我可以協助您。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Is it possible to extend our stay for one more night?
options: A. The night is very beautiful here.
B. Let me check if we have any rooms available.
C. You stayed here for three nights.
D. It is not possible to stay awake all night.
boss.explain: 原句：Is it possible to extend our stay for one more night? 意思：我們有可能多住一晚嗎？正確回應是 B. 讓我查一下我們是否還有空房。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What is the best route that bypasses the construction on Main Street?
options: A. The construction will finish next month.
B. I built that street a long time ago.
C. You should take First Avenue to bypass it completely.
D. Main Street is very beautiful in the spring.
boss.explain: 原句：What is the best route that bypasses the construction on Main Street? 意思：避開主街施工的最佳路線是什麼？正確回應是 C. 你應該走第一大道來完全避開它。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: How long is it going to take to clear the road after the landslide?
options: A. The road is very long and winding.
B. I took the road less traveled.
C. The landslide happened yesterday morning.
D. The authorities expect to have it open by tomorrow evening.
boss.explain: 原句：How long is it going to take to clear the road after the landslide? 意思：土石流後清理道路需要多長時間？正確回應是 D. 當局預計明天傍晚能開放通行。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you know anyone who can help us set up the barbecue grill?
options: A. My brother is pretty good at assembling things.
B. The barbecue was very delicious.
C. I know a place where we can buy a grill.
D. We set it up yesterday afternoon.
boss.explain: 原句：Do you know anyone who can help us set up the barbecue grill? 意思：你認識能幫我們組裝烤肉架的人嗎？正確回應是 A. 我弟弟很擅長組裝東西。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Were you thinking of going hiking if the weather clears up?
options: A. The weather is getting much worse.
B. Yes, but it looks like the rain won't stop.
C. I planned the entire trip carefully.
D. The hiking trail is closed for maintenance.
boss.explain: 原句：Were you thinking of going hiking if the weather clears up? 意思：天氣放晴的話你有考慮去爬山嗎？正確回應是 B. 是的，但看起來雨是不會停了。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Blog: Yesterday, while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died. I couldn't take any pictures of the sunset.
Q: What was the writer doing when the battery died?
options: A. Hiking up the mountain.
B. Taking pictures.
C. Fixing the camera.
D. Watching the sunset.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章明確提到「while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died (當我們正在爬山時，相機沒電了)」，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science News: The new telescope, which was built in Chile, has captured clear images of distant galaxies. It took ten years to construct.
Q: What is true about the telescope?
options: A. It was built in ten months.
B. It took a decade to build.
C. It is located in space.
D. It takes blurry pictures.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到 It took ten years (10年) to construct。ten years 也就是 a decade (十年)，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Notice: All candidates who wish to apply for the senior marketing position must submit a portfolio. Submissions are due this Friday.
Q: What is required from the applicants?
options: A. A job offer.
B. A reference letter.
C. A portfolio of their work.
D. A marketing degree.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：公告中說明申請資深行銷職位的候選人必須提交作品集 (must submit a portfolio)，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Bulletin: The local library is recruiting volunteers to read stories to children on weekends. Anyone who enjoys working with kids is welcome.
Q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: A. To sell books.
B. To hire librarians.
C. To host a weekend party.
D. To find weekend volunteers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：第一句提到圖書館正在招募週末講故事給小孩聽的志工 (recruiting volunteers)，故 D 為此公告的目的。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity Anecdote: The famous chef, whose restaurant recently earned three stars, admitted making a huge mistake in his early career.
Q: What did the chef admit?
options: A. Making an error in the past.
B. Losing his three stars.
C. Closing the restaurant.
D. Blaming his staff.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到名廚承認在他職涯早期犯了一個大錯 (admitted making a huge mistake)。mistake 同義替換為 error，選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Blog: While we were wandering through the night market, it began to pour. We had to seek shelter in a small dessert shop.
Q: Why did they go into the dessert shop?
options: A. Because they were hungry.
B. Because it started raining.
C. Because the market closed.
D. Because they wanted dessert.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到天空開始傾盆大雨 (began to pour)，所以他們必須去甜點店躲雨 (seek shelter)。選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Report: Researchers plan to launch a satellite next month. It will track climate patterns that affect agricultural production.
Q: What is the purpose of the new satellite?
options: A. To monitor space junk.
B. To send humans to space.
C. To track weather patterns.
D. To improve internet speed.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中說明發射衛星的目的是要追蹤影響農業生產的氣候模式 (track climate patterns)，故選 C (weather patterns)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Case: To boost sales, the company risks alienating its loyal customers by changing the core recipe of its popular drink.
Q: What is the company risking?
options: A. Losing their jobs.
B. Changing the company name.
C. Going bankrupt immediately.
D. Upsetting their loyal customer base.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：公司為了提升銷量更改核心配方，冒著疏遠忠實顧客 (alienating its loyal customers) 的風險。alienate 有使人疏遠、不悅之意，對應 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Notice: The city council has decided to expand the recycling program. Residents who separate their plastics will receive a small tax reduction.
Q: How can residents get a tax reduction?
options: A. By separating plastic waste.
B. By paying more taxes.
C. By expanding the city council.
D. By buying new bins.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到將塑膠分類的居民 (Residents who separate their plastics) 將獲得小幅減稅，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity News: The musician, who started playing the piano at age four, released her autobiography last week. She shares the struggles she faced.
Q: When did the musician start playing the piano?
options: A. When she was in high school.
B. When she was a toddler.
C. After she released her book.
D. Ten years ago.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章指出她四歲 (at age four) 開始彈鋼琴。四歲屬於幼童時期 (toddler)，故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Guide: The temple, which was originally built as a fortress in the 12th century, is now open to the public as a museum.
Q: What was the temple's original purpose?
options: A. It was a royal palace.
B. It was a secret prison.
C. It served as a fortress.
D. It was built in the 20th century.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到這座廟宇最初被建為堡壘 (built as a fortress)，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Article: The biologist was observing the monkeys when she noticed a rare behavior. They were using stones to crack open nuts.
Q: What did the biologist observe?
options: A. Monkeys fighting.
B. Monkeys eating bananas.
C. Monkeys climbing trees.
D. Monkeys using tools.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：生物學家觀察到猴子正在用石頭砸開堅果 (using stones to crack open nuts)，石頭在此被當作工具使用 (tools)，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Strategy: Management tends to hire candidates who have at least three years of overseas experience for the international department.
Q: Who is management likely to hire?
options: A. People with foreign work experience.
B. People with high salaries.
C. Fresh graduates.
D. Internal staff only.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到管理層傾向聘用至少有三年海外經驗 (overseas experience) 的候選人。overseas 替換為 foreign，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Update: The neighborhood watch committee, which was formed last year, has successfully reduced local crime rates by twenty percent.
Q: What has the committee achieved?
options: A. An increase in crime.
B. A decrease in crime.
C. A new neighborhood park.
D. Twenty new officers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：守望相助委員會成功將當地犯罪率降低了百分之二十 (reduced local crime rates by twenty percent)。reduce 對應 decrease，選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity Interview: During the talk, the actress described struggling to balance her career and family life when she first moved to Hollywood.

boss.desc:
【短文】Notice: We regret informing our members that free shipping is no longer available. You can choose to upgrade your membership to enjoy cheaper delivery fees.
Q: What change is the store making?
options: A. Offering free jackets.
B. Canceling free shipping.
C. Lowering membership fees.
D. Delivering items faster.
boss.explain: 公告開頭表示「free shipping is no longer available」（不再提供免運費服務），意味著商店取消了免運費。(B) 為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Health News: A recent study showed that teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks.
Q: Which group of people tends to crave unhealthy snacks?
options: A. Athletes in training.
B. Teenagers who lack sleep.
C. Adults eating vegetables.
D. People drinking green tea.
boss.explain: 研究指出「teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks」，亦即睡眠不足的青少年容易渴望不健康的零食。(B) 符合文意。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why did you hire a health coach?
B: I failed ___ a balanced meal plan on my own.
options: A. create
B. creating
C. to create
D. created
boss.explain: 動詞 fail 後面必須接不定詞（to + V）表示「未能做到某事」。因此 failed to create（無法制定）是唯一正確用法。(C) 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Research Article: The scientists hope to discover whether drinking green tea improves metabolism. They plan to publish the results next spring.
Q: What is the scientists' goal?
options: A. To publish a book on sleep.
B. To sleep seven hours.
C. To correct gym postures.
D. To discover green tea's effects.
boss.explain: 文章提到科學家的目的是「hope to discover whether drinking green tea improves metabolism」（希望能發現喝綠茶是否能改善新陳代謝），即了解綠茶的效果。(D) 正確。

boss.desc:

B. Near the window.

D. In the ground floor cafeteria.
boss.explain: 備忘錄中提到「The cafeteria that is located on the ground floor offers discounted meals」（位於一樓的員工餐廳提供折扣餐點）。(D) 為正確答案。

boss.desc:

Q: When did the printer jam?
options: A. While she was printing charts.
B. After she went home.
C. During the orientation.
D. When she logged in.
boss.explain: 報告指出「While the new assistant was printing the monthly charts, the printer jammed」，直接說明了印表機卡紙發生的時間點。(A) 完全符合原文。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: I am having trouble logging in.
B: You should think about ___ your password first.

B. resetting
C. reset
D. to resetting
boss.explain: 介系詞 about 後方若要接動詞，必須變成動名詞（V-ing）作為受詞。因此 think about resetting（考慮重設）為正確文法。(B) 正確。

boss.desc:

boss.desc:

boss.explain: 原句：The surgeon who performed the operation said that everything went smoothly.（負責手術的外科醫生說一切都很順利。）who 為關係代名詞修飾 surgeon（外科醫生）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I suggest resting for a few days rather than going back to work immediately.

B. I will try to follow your advice, doctor.
C. He suggested going to the beach.

boss.explain: 原句：I suggest resting for a few days rather than going back to work immediately.（我建議休息幾天，而不是馬上回去工作。）回應 B「醫生，我會試著聽從您的建議」是最佳對答。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

C. 我正在聽一個有趣的八卦，但我不敢跟別人說。
D. 我正在找一些有趣的書來讀，但沒有好書。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you interested in joining us for a hiking trip next Saturday?

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We ended up abandoning the project which we had been working on for months.
options: A. 我們最後完成了那個做了幾個月的專案。
B. 我們最後放棄了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。
C. 我們最後推遲了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。
D. 我們最後開始了那個討論了幾個月的專案。
boss.explain: 原句：We ended up abandoning the project which we had been working on for months.（我們最後放棄了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。）end up + V-ing（最後...），which 引導關係子句。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The museum strictly prohibits visitors from touching any of the exhibits.
options: A. The exhibit is very beautiful.
B. I will make sure to keep my hands to myself.
C. Visitors can buy tickets online.
D. I was touching the screen.
boss.explain: 原句：The museum strictly prohibits visitors from touching any of the exhibits.（博物館嚴格禁止遊客觸摸任何展品。）回應 B「我會確保管好我的手」表示理解並配合規定。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They were discussing the new policy when the video call disconnected.
options: A. 當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論新政策。
B. 當視訊通話連上時，他們正在討論新政策。
C. 他們因為新政策而中斷了視訊通話。
D. 當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論薪水。
boss.explain: 原句：They were discussing the new policy when the video call disconnected.（當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論新政策。）過去進行式表達當時進行的動作。

boss.desc:
【短文】Green Living: We urge everyone to consider buying local produce. Doing this helps cut down on transportation emissions.
Q: What does the writer suggest people consider doing?
options: A. To buy local produce.
B. Bought local produce.
C. Buying local produce.
D. Buy local produce.
boss.explain: 【文法與閱讀】題目問作者建議人們考慮做什麼。動詞 consider (考慮) 後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此正確選項應為 C (Buying local produce)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Eco-Friendly Campaign: The new recycling bin, which contains a smart sensor, automatically sorts paper and plastic. It will be placed in all major subway stations.
Q: What is true about the new recycling bin?
options: A. It was designed by the government.
B. It only collects plastic waste.
C. It requires manual sorting.
D. It can sort materials automatically.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文提到「automatically sorts paper and plastic (自動分類紙類與塑膠)」，對應 D 選項「它能自動分類回收物」。其他皆未提及或與文意相反。故選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】The government aims ___ a nationwide network of electric vehicle charging stations within five years.
options: A. to establish
B. establishing
C. establish
D. established
boss.explain: 【文法】動詞 aim 表示「目標在於、打算」時，後方接不定詞 (to V) 以構成 aim to do something。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】Many remote workers struggle with ___ their professional and personal lives at home.
options: A. separate
B. separated
C. separating
D. to separate
boss.explain: 【文法】struggle with 的 with 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞必須改成動名詞 (V-ing) 型態。故選 C (separating)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Office Memo: Yesterday afternoon, while the IT team was upgrading our servers, several employees experienced temporary login issues. The system is now fully restored.
Q: What caused the temporary login issues?
options: A. The server upgrade process.
B. A power outage.
C. A computer virus.
D. Employees forgetting passwords.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文指出，問題發生在「while the IT team was upgrading our servers (當 IT 團隊正在升級伺服器時)」，因此造成登入問題的原因是升級過程。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】Remote employees should avoid ___ entirely in their homes without taking breaks outside.
options: A. stay
B. to stay
C. staying
D. stayed
boss.explain: 【文法】avoid (避免) 是一個後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 的動詞，表示避免做某事。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Sports News: The local team, which had lost three consecutive games, finally secured a brilliant victory against the league champions.
Q: What is true about the local team?
options: A. They are the league champions.
B. They have never lost a game.
C. They recently won a game.
D. They decided to change their coach.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】文中提到球隊 secured a brilliant victory (取得漂亮的勝利)，這表示他們最近贏了一場比賽，與 C 選項相符。他們打敗的是聯盟冠軍，本身不是冠軍。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Live Commentary: The crowd was cheering wildly while the home team was pushing toward the goal line. Out of nowhere, the opposing goalkeeper intercepted the ball.
Q: What was happening when the ball was intercepted?
options: A. The game was paused.
B. The crowd was leaving the stadium.
C. The referee was blowing the whistle.
D. The home team was trying to score.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文說「while the home team was pushing toward the goal line (當主場球隊正朝球門線推進時)」，對方守門員攔截了球。推進球門線等同於 trying to score (嘗試得分)。故選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】If you want a table by the window, you had better attempt ___ it in advance.
options: A. make
B. to book
C. booking
D. booked
boss.explain: 【文法】attempt (嘗試/試圖) 後方應接不定詞 (to V)。選項 B (to book) 意為「預訂」，文法與語意皆正確。故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Restaurant Review: We strongly suggest trying their chocolate lava cake. It is incredibly rich and melts in your mouth instantly.
Q: What does the reviewer suggest doing?
options: A. Ordering a specific dessert.
B. Asking for a discount.
C. Sharing the cake with friends.
D. Avoiding the sweet dishes.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】評論者強烈建議嘗試「chocolate lava cake (巧克力熔岩蛋糕)」，這是一道特定的甜點 (a specific dessert)。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】The baker ___ created this spectacular wedding cake won a national culinary competition.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. who
D. whose
boss.explain: 【文法】先行詞 The baker (烘焙師) 為人，且在關係子句中作主詞 (創造蛋糕的人)，應填入主格關係代名詞 who。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Language Forum: Learners who immerse themselves in the target language daily tend to reach fluency much faster than those who only study grammar rules.
Q: According to the forum, who learns faster?
options: A. People who only study grammar.
B. People who ignore the target language.
C. People who regularly surround themselves with the language.
D. People who rarely practice speaking.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】文章提到「immerse themselves in the target language daily (每天讓自己沉浸在目標語言中)」的學習者能更快達到流利程度。immerse 意思接近 surround themselves with (讓自己置身於…之中)。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Classroom Incident: The teacher was explaining a complex math formula when the smartboard unexpectedly froze. She had to use a traditional whiteboard instead.
Q: What happened while the teacher was explaining the formula?
options: A. The digital equipment stopped working.
B. A student asked a difficult question.
C. The bell rang for the end of class.
D. The classroom lights went out.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文指出當老師在講解公式時，smartboard unexpectedly froze (電子白板突然當機不動了)，這對應到 A 選項的 The digital equipment stopped working (數位設備停止運作)。故選 A。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The anchor who presented the news seemed very distressed.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The contractor who gave us the estimate is waiting outside.
options: A. I was waiting outside in the freezing cold.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Would you consider lowering the shipping fee for bulk orders?

C. Bulk orders usually take more time to process.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The reporter denied fabricating the quotes in his article.
options: A. 記者否認在他的文章中捏造引語。
B. 編輯承認在他的報導中隱瞞了事實。
C. 主播拒絕為他的失言公開道歉。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was reviewing the blueprint when I noticed a structural flaw.
options: A. The blueprint which we use is very old.
B. That is concerning. Show me exactly where it is.
C. Reviewing documents is part of my daily job.
D. I noticed that you were wearing a new shirt.
boss.explain: I was reviewing the blueprint when I noticed a structural flaw.（我正在審查藍圖時注意到一個結構性缺陷。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The scholarship which she applied for is highly competitive.
options: A. 她參加的比賽競爭非常激烈。
B. 她申請的工作面試難度很高。
C. 她申請的獎學金競爭非常激烈。
D. 她參加的考試錄取率非常低。
boss.explain: The scholarship which she applied for is highly competitive.（她申請的獎學金競爭非常激烈。）

boss.desc: 【文法】The museum curator objected to ___ the rare artifact to the overseas exhibition.
options: A. send
B. sent
C. sending
D. be sent
boss.explain: 本題測驗片語中的動名詞。片語 object to 意為「反對」，其中的 to 是介系詞，而非不定詞的 to，因此後方必須接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。故答案為 sending。

boss.desc: 【文法】It is almost impossible for an average earner ___ a property in this expensive district.
options: A. acquiring
B. acquired
C. acquires
D. to acquire
boss.explain: 本題測驗不定詞的特殊句型。It is + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to V，表示「對某人來說做某事是...的」。真正的主詞是不定詞片語 to acquire a property，因此必須選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】Melatonin is a hormone ___ helps regulate your daily sleep cycle.
options: A. that
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 hormone（荷爾蒙）為事物，因此關代需使用 which 或 that。選項中僅 that 符合條件。who, whom, whose 皆用於與人相關或表所有格的情況。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Did the company catch the person who leaked the data? 
B: Yes, it was a former employee ___ access had not been properly revoked.
options: A. who
B. whose
C. which
D. whom
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞的所有格。後方的名詞 access（權限）屬於前方的 former employee（前員工），表示「這位前員工的權限」，因此必須使用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Is the charity gala still happening tonight? 
B: Yes, they ___ the venue when the storm suddenly hit, but everything is fine now.
options: A. decorate
B. have decorated
C. were decorating
D. will decorate
boss.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。when the storm suddenly hit 表示過去風暴來襲的瞬間，在那個瞬間他們「正在布置」場地，此持續動作需使用過去進行式 were decorating。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Do you remember the historian ___ we met at the conference? 
B: Yes, he specializes in ancient Egyptian culture.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. who
D. whom
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 historian（歷史學家）是人，在關係子句 "we met ___ at the conference" 中擔任 met 的受詞，因此最精確的用法是受格關係代名詞 whom。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they arguing? 
B: The residents demand ___ compensation from the construction company for the noise pollution.
options: A. to receive
B. receiving
C. received
D. receive
boss.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。動詞 demand（要求）後面必須接不定詞 (to + V) 當作受詞，表示要求去做某事。因此正確選項為 to receive，不能用動名詞 receiving。

boss.desc:
【短文】Sleep Journal: I was analyzing the sleep data from my smartwatch when I realized my deep sleep had significantly decreased. The therapist recommended eliminating caffeine after noon.
Q: What did the therapist suggest?
options: A. Buying a new watch
B. Stopping caffeine intake in the afternoon
C. Sleeping earlier
D. Analyzing the data more often
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解及字彙。治療師建議「eliminating caffeine after noon (中午過後戒除咖啡因)」。eliminate 意為消除、排除，與選項 B (Stopping caffeine intake in the afternoon) 意思完全相同。

boss.desc:
【短文】IT Advisory: Employees who receive emails requesting urgent wire transfers should verify the sender's identity. This is a common tactic used by scammers to bypass security.
Q: What should employees do if asked for an urgent wire transfer?
options: A. Send the money immediately
B. Ignore the email entirely
C. Confirm who actually sent the email
D. Change their password
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。短文中要求員工「verify the sender's identity (驗證寄件者的身分)」，verify 意指確認其真實性，因此選項 C「確認到底是誰寄了這封信」為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Charity Press Release: The non-profit organization, which focuses on providing clean water, is launching a new campaign in rural areas. They aim to build fifty wells by next year.
Q: What is the main focus of the organization?
options: A. Building schools
B. Donating food
C. Teaching farming
D. Supplying clean water
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中的第一句即提到組織的重點是「focuses on providing clean water (專注於提供乾淨水源)」，提供 (providing) 等同於供應 (supplying)，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Historical Article: While archaeologists were excavating the ancient tomb, they uncovered a hidden chamber containing gold coins. The discovery, which surprised everyone, rewrote local history.
Q: What were the archaeologists doing when they found the chamber?
options: A. Digging at the historical site
B. Selling gold coins
C. Writing a history book
D. Building a tomb
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解與字彙。文中提到「While archaeologists were excavating the ancient tomb (當考古學家正在挖掘古墓時)」。excavate (挖掘) 的同義詞為 dig，古墓也是歷史遺址，因此選項 A 符合文意。

boss.desc:
【短文】Housing Forum: Many young professionals put off buying a house due to soaring prices. Instead, they opt for renting modern apartments that offer shared amenities like gyms and pools.
Q: Why do young professionals delay purchasing houses?
options: A. They prefer small spaces
B. The prices are too high
C. They do not like houses
D. They want to live alone
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中指出年輕人推遲買房的原因是「due to soaring prices (因為飆升的房價)」。因此選項 B「價格太高」是正確的因果推論。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The itinerary that the travel agency provided seems rather exhausting for elderly participants.
options: A. 旅行社提供的行程對年長參與者來說似乎相當累人。
B. 參與這次旅行的老年人都覺得行程安排得很輕鬆。
C. 旅行社拒絕為老年人提供客製化的行程表。
D. 老年參與者要求旅行社修改原定的出發時間。
boss.explain: The itinerary that the travel agency provided seems rather exhausting for elderly participants.（旅行社提供的行程對年長參與者來說似乎相當累人。）itinerary 指行程，exhausting 為使人精疲力盡的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was discussing the budget constraints with the committee when the power suddenly went off.
options: A. Did you manage to save the spreadsheet before that happened?
B. The committee always meets on Tuesdays.
C. We are planning to increase the budget next year.
D. The power company will install a new meter soon.
boss.explain: I was discussing the budget constraints with the committee when the power suddenly went off.（我正在和委員會討論預算限制時，突然停電了。）A 選項「在那發生前你有成功存檔試算表嗎？」最符合職場情境的反應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Parents are encouraged to volunteer for the charity bazaar which is scheduled for next month.
options: A. 家長們被鼓勵為定於下個月舉行的慈善義賣活動擔任志工。
B. 學校要求家長必須參加下個月的家長會。
C. 志工們正在努力為家長籌集慈善捐款。
D. 下個月的義賣活動將由學生獨立舉辦。
boss.explain: Parents are encouraged to volunteer for the charity bazaar which is scheduled for next month.（家長們被鼓勵為定於下個月舉行的慈善義賣活動擔任志工。）be encouraged to V 被鼓勵去做...，which引導關係子句修飾 bazaar。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Despite the gloomy forecast, we decided to proceed with the outdoor exhibition.
options: A. I think it was a brave decision. Did it rain after all?
B. The exhibition was mostly about modern art.
C. I was predicting a sunny day for the event.
D. Indoor exhibitions are usually less crowded.
boss.explain: Despite the gloomy forecast, we decided to proceed with the outdoor exhibition.（儘管預報天氣陰沉，我們還是決定繼續舉辦戶外展覽。）A 選項「我認為這是個勇敢的決定。最後有下雨嗎？」回應自然。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She mentioned struggling to balance her professional responsibilities with her personal life.
options: A. 她提到在平衡專業職責與個人生活方面感到掙扎。
B. 她表示她的工作完全不影響她的私人時間。
C. 她正在尋找一份可以兼顧家庭的新工作。
D. 她抱怨主管總是給她太多專業任務。
boss.explain: She mentioned struggling to balance her professional responsibilities with her personal life.（她提到在平衡專業職責與個人生活方面感到掙扎。）mention + V-ing 表示提及做過或正在經歷的事，struggle 意為掙扎、努力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday clearly lacks practical experience in this field.
options: A. The field is located near the old factory.
B. I agree. We should probably keep searching for a better fit.
C. He has a lot of theoretical knowledge to share.
D. I was interviewing for a different position.
boss.explain: The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday clearly lacks practical experience in this field.（我們昨天面試的那位候選人顯然缺乏這個領域的實務經驗。）B 選項「我同意。我們可能應該繼續尋找更適合的人選」符合招募討論情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Instead of assigning more homework, the teacher emphasized participating in class discussions.
options: A. 老師沒有指派更多作業，而是強調參與課堂討論。
B. 老師不僅指派了更多作業，還要求學生參加討論。
C. 學生們拒絕寫作業，只願意參與課堂討論。
D. 老師認為寫作業比參與課堂討論更重要。
boss.explain: Instead of assigning more homework, the teacher emphasized participating in class discussions.（老師沒有指派更多作業，而是強調參與課堂討論。）Instead of 表示「而不是」，emphasize 後接動名詞表示強調的事情。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was looking forward to the scenic cruise, but the dense fog ruined the view entirely.
options: A. The cruise ship was built five years ago.
B. What a shame! You must be quite disappointed.
C. Fog consists of tiny water droplets.
D. I plan to take a scenic route tomorrow.
boss.explain: I was looking forward to the scenic cruise, but the dense fog ruined the view entirely.（我本來很期待這趟風景遊輪之旅，但濃霧完全破壞了景色。）B 選項「真可惜！你一定很失望」傳達了同情。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The supervisor who oversees the logistics department is known for being extremely meticulous.
options: A. 負責監督物流部的主管以極度細心聞名。
B. 物流部的員工抱怨主管的要求太過苛刻。
C. 那位主管正在尋找一位細心的物流助理。
D. 大家都知道物流部的主管即將被調職。
boss.explain: The supervisor who oversees the logistics department is known for being extremely meticulous.（負責監督物流部的主管以極度細心聞名。）oversee 意為監督，be known for 意為以...聞名，meticulous 為一絲不苟的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you considering appealing the decision that the committee made last week?
options: A. Yes, I firmly believe they misinterpreted the regulations.
B. The committee room is currently occupied.
C. I was deciding what to eat for lunch.
D. The appeal process is generally quite simple.
boss.explain: Are you considering appealing the decision that the committee made last week?（你正在考慮對委員會上週做的決定提出申訴嗎？）A 選項「是的，我堅信他們誤解了規定」符合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They were modifying the assembly line to boost production efficiency.
options: A. 他們正在修改裝配線以提高生產效率。
B. 裝配線的修改導致了生產效率下降。
C. 他們計畫明年關閉這條效率低下的裝配線。
D. 工人們正在抱怨裝配線的設計有缺陷。
boss.explain: They were modifying the assembly line to boost production efficiency.（他們正在修改裝配線以提高生產效率。）modify 意為修改，boost 表示提升，production efficiency 為生產效率。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: It is crucial to verify the references that the applicant provided on their resume.
options: A. The resume should be printed on high-quality paper.
B. I completely agree. I'll start making those calls this afternoon.
C. The applicant arrived fifteen minutes early.
D. I was verifying my bank account balance online.
boss.explain: It is crucial to verify the references that the applicant provided on their resume.（核實申請人在履歷上提供的推薦人是非常重要的。）B 選項「我完全同意。我今天下午就開始打那些電話」最符合招募流程。
